持握這面盾牌期間，你可以使用下列額外屬性。

【強力猛擊】當你採取攻擊動作時，你可以使用這面盾牌，對位於你5呎內的一個目標進行其中一次攻擊檢定。將你的熟練加值與力量調整值加到該攻擊檢定上。命中時，盾牌對目標造成等同於2d6+2加上你力量調整值的力場傷害，若目標為生物，你可以將其直接推離你至多10呎。若該生物的體型與你相同或更小，你也可以將其擊倒，使其陷入伏地狀態。

【庇護領域】當你或位於你5呎內一名你所能看見的盟友成為一次攻擊的目標，或對抗一個效應區域進行豁免時，以一個反應，你可以使用這面盾牌創造一道以你為原點且無法移動的5呎發散區域。當發散區域出現時，任何未完全位於其中的生物或物件都會被推至該區域外最近的未佔據空間。觸發此反應的攻擊或效應區域對發散區域內的生物與物件不產生效應。只要你維持專注，發散區域便持續存在，至多1分鐘。任何東西都無法進出該發散區域。區域內的生物或物件不會受到來自區域外的攻擊或效應傷害，區域內的生物也無法對區域外的任何東西造成傷害。此屬性一經使用，直到下個黎明前，你都無法再次使用。

Armor, +1, +2, or +3.name: 護甲+1、+2、+3
Armor, +1, +2, or +3.description:
護甲（任意輕甲、中甲或重甲），珍稀（+1）、極珍稀（+2）、傳說（+3）

穿戴這套護甲期間，你的AC獲得加值。加值取決於護甲的稀有度。

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgFoundryRefere.JournalEntryPage.Ok4iCgD25ENgoRxE cite=false caption=false classes="hide-in-embed"]

Burnt Othur Fumes.description:
Inhaled Poison

A creature subjected to Burnt Othur Fumes must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) Poison damage, and it must repeat the save at the start of each of its turns. On each successive failed save, the creature takes 3 (1d6) Poison damage. After three successful saves, the poison ends.
Burnt Othur Fumes.name: Burnt Othur Fumes

Slaying Save.condition: when the specified creature type is damaged by this ammunition
Slaying Save.name: Slaying Save

Ammunition of Slaying.name: Ammunition of Slaying
Ammunition of Slaying.description:
This magic ammunition is meant to slay creatures of a particular type, which the DM chooses or determines randomly by rolling on the table below. If a creature of that type takes damage from the ammunition, the creature makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking an extra 6d10 Force damage on a failed save or half as much extra damage on a successful one.

After dealing its extra damage to a creature, the ammunition becomes nonmagical.

Creature Type Table (click to expand)

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgSlayingAmmuni rollable]

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgFoundryRefere.JournalEntryPage.Ok4iCgD25ENgoRxE cite=false caption=false classes="hide-in-embed"]

Bag of Holding.name: 次元袋
Bag of Holding.description:
這個袋子的內部空間比其外表尺寸看起來更大，內部大約是2呎見方、4呎深，可以容納至多500磅、體積不超過64立方呎的東西。無論裝了什麼，這個袋子總是重5磅。從袋子裡取出東西需要採取利用動作。

若次元袋超載，或是袋子被戳破、撕裂，其將因此被摧毀，所裝載的東西將散落到星界位面各處。若袋子被內外翻轉，則其所裝載的東西將完好無損地掉落出來，但再次使用袋子之前必須將其恢復原狀。次元袋內所容納的空氣量足以維持呼吸10分鐘，並由其中所有需要呼吸的生物均分。

把次元袋放入由@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgHewardsHandyH]{霍華德的便利袋}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPortableHole0]{便攜式次元洞}或其他類似物品所創造的異次元空間內時，將會立即同時摧毀兩件物品並開啟一道通往星界位面的傳送門。傳送門產生於其中一件物品被放入另一件物品之處。任何位於以傳送門為中心10呎半徑球形區域內的生物將被吸入門內，並送往星界位面中的隨機地點。然後傳送門即時關閉，傳送門是單向的且無法被再次開啟。

Dust of Sneezing and Choking.name: 噴嚏窒息塵
Dust of Sneezing and Choking.description:
奇物，非普通

這種粉末通常被裝在小盒子裡，其分量足夠使用一次。這種粉末看起來像是@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgDustOfDisappe]{無蹤塵}，對其施放鑑定術也會顯示出這樣的結果。

你可以採取利用動作把這種粉末灑向空中，迫使你自己以及位於以你為中心30呎發散區域內的每個生物進行一次DC 15的體質豁免。構裝體、元素、軟泥、植物和不死生物在豁免中自動成功。

豁免失敗的生物會不停打噴嚏，陷入失能狀態並窒息。受影響的生物能在每次自己的回合結束時[[/save ability=con dc=15]]{再次進行該豁免}，一旦豁免成功，其身上的效應也將隨之終止。任何成為@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplLesserRest]{次級復原術}法術目標的生物，其身上的該效應也會終止。

Incapacitated and Suffocating (Sneezing).name: 失能且窒息（打噴嚏）
Incapacitated and Suffocating (Sneezing).description:
來源：@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgDustOfSneezin]
該生物陷入失能狀態並窒息。該生物能在每次自己的回合結束時[[/save ability=con dc=15]]{再次進行該豁免}，一旦豁免成功，其身上的效應也將隨之終止。任何成為@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplLesserRest]{次級復原術}法術目標的生物，其身上的該效應也會終止。

Gem of Brightness.name: 光彩奪目寶石
Gem of Brightness.description:
奇物，非普通

這塊稜形寶石具有50點充能。持握該寶石期間，你可以採取魔法動作並使用寶石的三道命令詞之一，造成下列其中一項效應：

【第一命令詞】寶石發出亮光，提供半徑30呎的明亮光照，並再延伸30呎的微光光照。此效應不會消耗充能。其將持續到你採取附贈動作再次說出該命令詞，或你使用寶石的另一項功能為止。

【第二命令詞】你消耗1點充能，令寶石向位於你60呎內一名你所能看見的生物發出一道耀眼的光束。該生物必須成功通過一次DC 15的體質豁免，否則陷入&Reference[Blinded apply=false]{目盲}狀態，持續1分鐘。該生物可以在其每個回合結束時重複豁免，豁免成功則結束其身上的效應。

【第三命令詞】你消耗5點充能，令寶石向30呎錐形區域放出刺眼的光芒。該錐形區域內的每個生物必須進行豁免，如同被第二命令詞所創造的光束擊中一般。

耗盡充能後，此寶石變為價值50gp的非魔法寶石。

Demon Armor.description:
護甲（任意輕甲、中甲或重甲），極珍稀（需同調）

穿戴這套護甲期間，你的AC獲得+1加值，且你知曉深淵語。此外，護甲如利爪般的護腕令你的徒手打擊造成1d8揮砍傷害，取代原本的鈍擊傷害，且你徒手打擊的攻擊檢定與傷害擲骰獲得+1加值。

【詛咒】一旦你穿上這套被詛咒的護甲，除非你成為移除詛咒法術或類似魔法的目標，否則你無法脫下該護甲。穿戴該護甲期間，你對惡魔進行的攻擊檢定，以及對抗其法術與特殊能力所進行的豁免，皆具有劣勢。

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgFoundryRefere.JournalEntryPage.Ok4iCgD25ENgoRxE cite=false caption=false classes="hide-in-embed"]
Demon Armor.name: 惡魔護甲

Torpor.description:
Ingested Poison

A creature subjected to Torpor poison must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the &Reference[Poisoned] condition for [[/r 4d6]] hours. The creature's Speed is halved while the creature is Poisoned in this way.
Torpor.name: Torpor

Charm of Animal Conjuring.name: Charm of Animal Conjuring
Charm of Animal Conjuring.description:
超自然贈禮（護咒）

This Charm allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplConjureAni]{Conjure Animals}. Once used three times, the Charm vanishes from you.

Belt of Giant Strength (hill).description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgBeltOfGiantSt]

While wearing this belt, your Strength changes to 21. The type of giant determines the score. The item has no effect on you if your Strength without the belt is equal to or greater than 21.
Belt of Giant Strength (hill).name: Belt of Giant Strength (hill)

Revolver.description:
Reload (6 shots)

Foundry Note

This item includes a max use of 6 for ammunition tracking. The Reload activities can be used to reset that amount.
Revolver.name: Revolver

Philter of Love.name: 迷情媚藥
Philter of Love.description:
藥水，非普通

喝下這瓶藥劑後10分鐘內，你會被你看見的下一個生物所吸引，並使你陷入&Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑}狀態，持續1小時。

這種玫瑰色的氣泡狀液體中，有一個容易被忽略的心形氣泡。

attack.chatFlavor: 額外傷害：對邪魔或不死生物造成2d6光耀傷害

Mace of Disruption.name: 瓦解之錘

Frightened.name: 恐慌
Frightened.description: 豁免成功時，該生物陷入&Reference[Frightened apply=false]{恐慌}狀態，直到你的下個回合結束前。

Mace of Disruption.description:
武器（@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepMace000000]{硬頭錘}），珍稀（需同調）

當你以這把魔法武器命中一名邪魔或不死生物時，該生物額外承受2d6光耀傷害。若目標承受此傷害後的生命值為25或更少，則必須成功通過一次DC 15的感知豁免，否則被摧毀。豁免成功時，該生物陷入&Reference[Frightened apply=false]{恐慌}狀態，直到你的下個回合結束。

【照明】持握這把武器期間，該武器散發出20呎半徑的明亮光照，以及額外20呎的微光光照。

Sphere of Annihilation.name: 湮滅法球
Sphere of Annihilation.description:
奇物, Legendary

This 2-foot-diameter black sphere is a hole in the multiverse, hovering in space and stabilized by a magical field surrounding it.

The sphere obliterates all matter it passes through and all matter that passes through it. Artifacts are the exception. Unless an Artifact is susceptible to damage from a Sphere of Annihilation, it passes through the sphere unscathed. Anything else that touches the sphere but isn’t wholly engulfed and obliterated by it takes 8d10 Force damage.

Controlling the Sphere. A Sphere of Annihilation is stationary until someone takes control of it. If you are within 60 feet of a sphere, you can take a Magic action to make a DC 25 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a successful check, you control the sphere until the start of your next turn, and if it was under another creature’s control, that creature loses control of the sphere. On a failed check, the sphere moves 10 feet toward you in a straight line.

While in control of the sphere, you can take a Bonus Action to cause it to move in one direction of your choice, up to a number of feet equal to 5 times your Intelligence modifier (minimum 5 feet). Any creature whose space the sphere enters must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be touched by it, taking 8d10 Force damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is obliterated, leaving its possessions behind but no other physical remains.

Sphere Interactions. If the sphere comes into contact with a planar portal (such as that created by the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGate000000]{Gate} spell) or an extradimensional space (such as that within a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPortableHole0]{Portable Hole}), the DM determines randomly what happens using the following table.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgSphereOfAnnih]

Ring of the Ram.name: 公羊戒指
Ring of the Ram.description:
Ring，珍稀（需同調）

This ring has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 to 3 charges to make a ranged spell attack against one creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The ring produces a spectral ram’s head and makes its attack roll with a +7 bonus. On a hit, for each charge you spend, the target takes 2d10 Force damage and is pushed 5 feet away from you.

Alternatively, you can expend 1 to 3 of the ring’s charges as a Magic action to try to break a nonmagical object you can see within 60 feet of yourself that isn’t being worn or carried. The ring makes a Strength check with a +5 bonus for each charge you spend.

Ring of Swimming.description:
Ring，非普通

You have a Swim Speed of 40 feet while wearing this ring.
Ring of Swimming.name: 游泳戒指

Immovable Rod.name: 不動權杖
Immovable Rod.description:
權杖，非普通

這根鐵製權杖的一端有一枚按鈕。你可以採取利用動作按下按鈕，使權杖以魔法固定在原處。直到你或另一名生物採取利用動作再次按下按鈕前，權杖都不會移動，即使這違反重力亦然。權杖最多能承受8,000磅的重量，超過此重量會使權杖失效並掉落。一名生物可以採取利用動作進行一次DC 30的力量（運動）檢定，檢定成功時可將固定的權杖移動至多10呎。

Javelin of Lightning.description:
武器（@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepJavelin000]{標槍}），非普通

每次你以這把魔法武器進行攻擊檢定並命中時，你可以使其造成閃電傷害，取代穿刺傷害。

【閃電束】當你向位於你120呎內的一個目標投擲這把武器時，你可以放棄進行遠程攻擊檢定，改為將武器變為一道閃電束。這道閃電束在你與目標之間形成一道寬5呎的直線區域。目標與該區域內每個其他生物（不包括你）都進行一次DC 13的敏捷豁免，失敗時承受4d6閃電傷害，成功時則傷害減半。緊接在你造成此傷害後，武器重新出現在你手中。直到下個黎明前，你無法再次使用此屬性。

【Foundry 註記】

使用攻擊行動擲傷害時，你可以在閃電與穿刺之間選擇，該行動也會記住你上次的選擇。
Javelin of Lightning.name: 閃電標槍

Potion of Growth.name: 成長藥水
Potion of Growth.description:
藥水，非普通

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你獲得@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplEnlargeRed]{變巨/縮小術}法術的「變巨」效應，持續10分鐘（無須專注）。

這瓶藥水內的紅色液體將連續地從一個小球擴散蔓延，將周圍的清澈液體染紅，然後再迅速聚合成球。搖晃瓶子也無法打斷這個過程。

Puzzle.name: Puzzle
Puzzle.description: Permanently reduce your Intelligence or Wisdom by 1d4 + 1 (to a minimum score of 1). You can draw one additional card beyond your declared draws.

Card Effect.condition: Card's effect occurs immediately upon draw
Card Effect.name: Card Effect

Potion of Giant Strength (Cloud).name: 雲巨人之力藥水
Potion of Giant Strength (Cloud).description:
藥水，極珍稀

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你的力量屬性值會在1小時內變為27。巨人的種類決定該屬性值。若你的力量等於或高於該值，這瓶藥水對你無效。

這瓶藥水的透明液體中漂浮著一縷形似巨人指甲的光絲。

Anstruth Harp Instrument of the Bards.name: Anstruth Harp Instrument of the Bards
Anstruth Harp Instrument of the Bards.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgInstrumentOfT]{Instrument of the Bards}

An Instrument of the Bards is superior to an ordinary instrument in every way.

A creature that attempts to play the instrument without being attuned to it must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=15 format=long]] or take [[/damage 2d4 type=psychic]] damage.

You can play the instrument to cast one of its spells. Once the instrument has been used to cast a spell, it can’t be used to cast that spell again until the next dawn. The spells use your spellcasting ability and spell save DC.

Explosive Emanation.condition: Take Fire damage from failing a saving throw
Explosive Emanation.name: Explosive Emanation

Helm of Brilliance.description:
奇物，非常珍稀（需同調）

This helm is set with [[/r 1d10 # Diamonds]] diamonds, [[/r 2d10 # Rubies]] rubies, [[/r 3d10 # Fire Opals]] fire opals, and [[/r 4d10 # Opals]] opals. Any gem pried from the helm crumbles to dust. When all the gems are removed or destroyed, the helm loses its magic.

You gain the following benefits while wearing the helm.

Diamond Light. As long as it has at least one diamond, the helm emits a 30-foot Emanation. When at least one Undead is within that area, the Emanation is filled with Dim Light. Any Undead that starts its turn in that area takes 1d6 Radiant damage.

Fire Opal Flames. As long as the helm has at least one fire opal, you can take a Magic action to cause one weapon you are holding to burst into flames. The flames emit Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet. The flames are harmless to you and the weapon. When you hit with an attack using the blazing weapon, the target takes an extra 1d6 Fire damage. The flames last until you take a Bonus Action to extinguish them or until you drop or stow the weapon.

Ruby Resistance. As long as the helm has at least one ruby, you have Resistance to Fire damage.

Spells. You can cast one of the following spells (save DC 18), using one of the helm’s gems of the specified type as a component: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDaylight00]{Daylight} (opal), @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFireball00]{Fireball} (fire opal), @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplPrismaticS]{Prismatic Spray} (diamond), or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWallofFire]{Wall of Fire} (ruby). The gem is destroyed when the spell is cast and disappears from the helm.

Taking Fire Damage. Roll [[/r 1d20]] if you are wearing the helm and take Fire damage as a result of failing a saving throw against a spell. On a roll of 1, the helm emits beams of light from its remaining gems and is then destroyed. Each creature within a 60-foot Emanation originating from you must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be struck by a beam, taking Radiant damage equal to the number of gems in the helm.

Diamonds:

Rubies:

Fire Opals:

Opals:

Foundry Note

You can track the number of each gem in the description.

If you roll a 1 as part of the Taking Fire Damage property use the Explosive Emanation activity. It will allow you to enter the number of gems remaining in the helm and increase the damage automatically.
Helm of Brilliance.name: 光輝頭盔

Nine Lives Stealer.description:
武器（任意簡易或軍用），非常珍稀（需同調）

You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

Life Stealing. The weapon has [[/r 1d8 + 1]] charges. When you attack a creature that has fewer than 100 Hit Points with this weapon and roll a 20 on the d20 for the attack roll, the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be slain instantly as the sword tears its life force from its body. Constructs and Undead succeed on the save automatically. The weapon loses 1 charge if the creature is slain. When the weapon has no charges remaining, it loses this property.

Foundry Note

The Life Stealing activity should be updated with its max uses set to the number of charges rolled.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgFoundryRefere.JournalEntryPage.Ok4iCgD25ENgoRxE cite=false caption=false classes="hide-in-embed"]
Nine Lives Stealer.name: Nine Lives Stealer

Life Stealing.condition: when you roll a 20 on an attack against a creature with fewer than 100 Hit Points
Life Stealing.name: Life Stealing

Wand of Conducting.description:
魔杖，普通

這根魔杖具有3點充能。持握魔杖期間，你可以採取魔法動作，消耗1充能，並揮舞魔杖以創造管弦樂。該音樂在120呎內都能聽見，並在你停止揮舞魔杖時結束。

【恢復充能】此魔杖每日黎明時恢復所有已消耗的充能。若你消耗了魔杖的最後1充能，擲[[/r 1d20]]。若結果為1，魔杖會在一聲哀傷的低音號聲中化為塵土並被摧毀。
Wand of Conducting.name: 指揮魔杖

Book of Vile Darkness.description:
奇物, Artifact（需同調）

The contents of this foul manuscript are the meat and drink of the wicked. It contains knowledge so horrid that to even glimpse the scrawled pages invites doom.

Most believe the lich-god Vecna authored the Book of Vile Darkness. He recorded in its pages every horrid idea, every corrupt thought, and every example of foul magic he came across or devised.

Other practitioners of evil have added their own input to the book’s catalog of vile knowledge. Their additions are clear, for the writers of later works stitched whatever they were writing into the tome or, in some cases, made notations and additions to existing text. There are places where pages are missing, torn, or covered so completely with ink, blood, and scratches that the original text can’t be divined.

Nature can’t abide the book’s presence. Ordinary plants wither in its presence, common animals are unwilling to approach it, and the book gradually destroys whatever it touches. Even stone cracks and turns to powder if the book rests on it long enough.

Whenever a creature that isn’t a Fiend or an Undead attunes to the Book of Vile Darkness , that creature makes a [[/save ability=cha dc=17 format=long]]. On a failed save, the creature is magically transformed into a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.dmgnpcLarva00000]{Larva} under the DM’s control. Only a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} spell can reverse this vile transformation.

A creature attuned to the book must spend 80 hours reading and studying it to digest its contents and use its Adjusted Ability Scores, Tireless Form, Spells, Vile Lore, and Vile Speech properties.

The Book of Vile Darkness remains with you only as long as you strive to work evil in the world. If you fail to perform at least one evil act within the span of 10 days, or if you willingly perform a good act, the book disappears, your Attunement to it ends immediately, and you lose all benefits granted by it. If you die while attuned to the book, an entity of great evil claims your soul. You can’t be restored to life by any means while your soul remains imprisoned.

Adjusted Ability Scores.

One ability score of your choice increases by 2, to a maximum of 24. Another ability score of your choice decreases by 2, to a minimum of 3. The book can’t adjust your ability scores again.

Tireless Form.

While the book is on your person, you have Immunity to the Exhaustion condition.

Random Properties.

The Book of Vile Darkness has the following random properties (see “Artifacts” in this chapter):

  • 3 minor beneficial properties
  • 1 major beneficial property
  • 3 minor detrimental properties
  • 2 major detrimental properties
Spells.

While holding the book and holding it, you can cast the following spells (save DC 18) from it:

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplAnimateDea]{Animate Dead}
  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplCircleofDe]{Circle of Death}
  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDominateMo]{Dominate Monster}
  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFingerofDe]{Finger of Death}

Once you use the book to cast a spell, you can’t cast that spell again from it until the next dawn.

Vile Lore.

You can reference the Book of Vile Darkness whenever you make an Intelligence check to recall information about some aspect of evil, such as lore about demons. When you do so, you have Advantage on that check.

At the DM’s discretion, the book might reveal secrets no mortal should know, such as the true names of powerful Fiends, foul rites that allow one to transform into a death knight or lich, or long-lost spells crafted by beings so evil their names ought never to be spoken aloud.

Vile Speech.

While the book is on your person, you can take a Magic action to recite words from its pages in a foul, dead language. Each time you do so, you take [[/damage 1d12 type=psychic]] damage, and each creature within 15 feet of you takes 3d6 Psychic damage unless the creature is a Fiend or an Undead.

Destroying the Book.

The Book of Vile Darkness allows pages to be torn from it, but any evil lore contained on those pages finds its way back into the book eventually, usually when a new author adds pages to the tome.

If a solar tears the book in two, the book is destroyed for [[/r 1d100#Years]] years, after which it re-forms in some far corner of the multiverse.

A creature attuned to the book for 100 years can unearth a phrase hidden in the original text that, when translated to Celestial and spoken aloud, destroys both the speaker and the book in a flash of radiance. However, as long as evil exists in the multiverse, the book re-forms [[/r 100* 1d10#Years]]{1d10 × 100} years later.
Book of Vile Darkness.name: Book of Vile Darkness

Dragon Scale Mail.name: 龍鱗甲

護甲（鱗甲），極珍稀（需同調）

龍鱗甲由一種龍的鱗片製成。有時龍會收集自己脫落的鱗片並將其當作禮物贈送，有時則是獵人小心保存死去龍類的皮。在這兩種情況下，龍鱗甲都極為珍貴。

穿戴這套護甲期間，你的AC獲得+1加值，你對抗龍類吐息武器所進行的豁免具有優勢，且對一種傷害類型具有抗力；該傷害類型取決於提供鱗片的龍種（見附表）。

此外，你可以採取魔法動作，集中感官，辨識位於你30哩內、與這套護甲類型相同且距離最近的龍，並得知其距離與方向。直到下個黎明前，你無法再次採取此動作。

Thunderous Greatclub.name: Thunderous Greatclub
Thunderous Greatclub.description:
Weapon (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepGreatclub0]{Greatclub})，非常珍稀（需同調）

While you are attuned to this magic weapon, your Strength is 20 unless your Strength is already equal to or greater than that score. The weapon deals an extra 1d8 Thunder damage to any creature it hits and an extra 3d8 Thunder damage to objects it hits that aren’t being worn or carried.

The weapon has the following additional properties.

Clap of Thunder. As a Magic action, you can strike the weapon against a hard surface to create a loud clap of thunder audible out to 300 feet. You also create a 30-foot Cone of thunderous energy. Each creature in the Cone must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition. Nonmagical objects in the Cone that aren’t being worn or carried take [[/damage 3d8 type=thunder]] damage.

Earthquake. As a Magic action, you can strike the weapon against the ground to create an intense seismic disturbance in a 50-foot-radius circle centered on the point of impact. Structures in contact with the ground in that area take 50 Bludgeoning damage, and each creature on the ground in that area must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition. If that creature is also concentrating, it must succeed on a [[/save con 20]] saving throw or its Concentration is broken. In addition, you can cause a 30-foot-deep, 10-foot-wide fissure to open up on the ground anywhere in the area. Any creature on a spot where the fissure opens must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, falling into the fissure on a failed save or moving with the fissure’s edge on a successful one. Any structure on a spot where the fissure opens collapses into the fissure. Once you use this property, it can’t be used again until the next dawn.

Rockslide.name: Rockslide
Rockslide.description:
Deadly Hazard (Levels 1–4)

Actor: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.dmgRockslide0000]{Rockslide}

When a rockslide occurs, every creature in its path makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 11 (2d10) Bludgeoning damage, has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition, and moves with the rockslide. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

When the rockslide stops, its space becomes &Reference[Difficult Terrain], and all Prone creatures in its space are buried under rocks and debris. A creature buried in this way has the &Reference[Restrained] condition and has &Reference[Total Cover]. As an action, a creature can try to crawl out from under the rock pile. If the creature succeeds on a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check, it is no longer Restrained; instead, it has the Prone condition and is atop the rock pile. If the check fails, the creature remains buried and gains 1 &Reference[Exhaustion] level.

A creature that has neither the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] nor the Restrained condition can spend 1 minute freeing another creature buried by the rockslide.

At Higher Levels. You can scale this hazard for higher levels by increasing the Bludgeoning damage as follows: 22 (4d10) at levels 5–10, 55 (10d10) at levels 11–16, and 99 (18d10) at levels 17–20.

Ring of Protection.description:
Ring，珍稀（需同調）

You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws while wearing this ring.

Art Object (7,500 GP).name: Art Object (7,500 GP)
Art Object (7,500 GP).description: Idols cast of solid gold, necklaces studded with precious stones, paintings of ancient kings, bejeweled dishes—art objects include all these and more.

Ring, Legendary（需同調）

While wearing this ring, you can take a Magic action to give yourself the &Reference[Invisible] condition. You remain Invisible until the ring is removed or until you take a Bonus Action to become visible again.

Enhanced Awareness: Initiative and Perce.description: While this dark-blue rhomboid orbits your head, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks.

Ioun Stone of Awareness.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgIounStone0000]{Ioun Stone}

When you take a Magic action to toss an Ioun Stone into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three Ioun Stones orbiting your head at the same time.

As a Utilize action, you can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head. If your Attunement to an Ioun Stone ends while it’s orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

While this dark-blue rhomboid orbits your head, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks.
Ioun Stone of Awareness.name: 艾恩石，警覺

Staff of the Magi.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbafcStaffalsoa]{Staff}, Legendary （需由術士、契術師或法師同調）

This staff has 50 charges and can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. While you hold it, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls.

Spell Absorption. While holding the staff, you have Advantage on saving throws against spells. In addition, you can take a Reaction when another creature casts a spell that targets only you. If you do, the staff absorbs the magic of the spell, canceling its effect and gaining a number of charges equal to the absorbed spell’s level. However, if doing so brings the staff’s total number of charges above 50, the staff explodes as if you activated its Retributive Strike (see below).

The staff is destroyed and releases its magic in an explosion that fills a 30-foot Emanation originating from itself. You have a 50 percent chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion ([[/r 1d2]], teleported on a 1). If you fail to avoid the effect, you take Force damage equal to 16 times the number of charges in the staff. Each other creature in the area makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to 6 times the number of charges in the staff. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

Horn of Valhalla: Condition Immunity.name: Horn of Valhalla: Condition Immunity
Horn of Valhalla: Condition Immunity.description: The spirits look like living, breathing warriors, and they have Immunity to the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] and &Reference[Frightened apply=false] conditions.

Iron Horn of Valhalla.name: 瓦爾哈拉黑鐵號角
Iron Horn of Valhalla.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgHornofValhall]{Horn of Valhalla}

Requirement: Proficiency with all Martial weapons

Spirits: 5

You can take a Magic action to blow this horn. In response, warrior spirits from the plane of Ysgard appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you. Each spirit uses the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.kz1t6xeXVwODpYb2]{Berserker} stat block and returns to Ysgard after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 Hit Points. The spirits look like living, breathing warriors, and they have Immunity to the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] and &Reference[Frightened apply=false] conditions. Once you use the horn, it can’t be used again until 7 days have passed.

If you blow the horn without meeting its requirement, the summoned spirits attack you. If you meet the requirement, they are Friendly to you and your allies and follow your commands.

Animated Shield.name: 活化盾
Animated Shield.description: 盾牌懸浮在你所佔據的空間中保護你，如同你正持用盾牌一般，同時讓你的雙手空出來。

護甲（盾牌），極珍稀（需同調）

持握這面盾牌期間，你可以採取附贈動作使其活化。盾牌會飛到空中，懸浮在你所佔據的空間中保護你，如同你正持用盾牌一般，同時讓你的雙手空出來。盾牌保持活化1分鐘，直到你採取附贈動作終止此效應，或直到你死亡或陷入&Reference[Incapacitated apply=false]{失能}狀態，此時盾牌會落到地上，或者若你有一隻空閒的手，則會落入你手中。

Mirror of Life Trapping.name: 攝心魔鏡
Mirror of Life Trapping.description:
奇物，非常珍稀

When this 4-foot-tall, 2-foot-wide mirror is viewed indirectly, its surface shows faint images of creatures. The mirror weighs 50 pounds, and it has AC 11, HP 10, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage, and Vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage. It shatters and is destroyed when reduced to 0 Hit Points.

If the mirror is hanging on a vertical surface and you are within 5 feet of it, you can take a Magic action and use a command word to activate it. It remains activated until you take a Magic action and repeat the command word to deactivate it.

Any creature other than you that sees its reflection in the activated mirror while within 30 feet of the mirror must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be trapped, along with anything it is wearing or carrying, in one of the mirror’s twelve extradimensional cells. A creature that knows the mirror’s nature makes the save with Advantage, and Constructs succeed on the save automatically.

An extradimensional cell is an infinite expanse filled with thick fog that reduces visibility to 10 feet. Creatures trapped in the mirror’s cells don’t age, and they don’t need to eat, drink, or sleep. A creature trapped within a cell can escape using magic that permits planar travel. Otherwise, the creature is confined to the cell until freed.

If the mirror traps a creature but its twelve extradimensional cells are already occupied, the mirror frees one trapped creature at random to accommodate the new prisoner. A freed creature appears in an unoccupied space within sight of the mirror but facing away from it. If the mirror is shattered, all creatures it contains are freed and appear in unoccupied spaces near it.

While within 5 feet of the mirror, you can take a Magic action to name one creature trapped in it or call out a particular cell by number. The creature named or contained in the named cell appears as an image on the mirror’s surface. You and the creature can then communicate.

In a similar way, you can take a Magic action and use a second command word to free one creature trapped in the mirror. The freed creature appears, along with its possessions, in the unoccupied space nearest to the mirror and facing away from it.

Placing the mirror inside an extradimensional space created by a Bag of Holding, Portable Hole, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10 feet of the gate and not behind Total Cover is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can’t be reopened.

Foundry Note

This item has a max uses of 12 which can be used to track the number of creatures trapped within the mirror. The Add/Free Trapped Creature activities can be used to increment/decrement that number.

Potion of Water Breathing.description:
藥水，非普通

飲用這瓶藥水後，你可以在水下呼吸24小時。

這瓶藥水的混濁綠色液體聞起來有海水的氣味，其中漂浮著一個水母狀的氣泡。

奇物，非普通

在你坐於這副鞍座上並跨騎坐騎期間，這副鞍座會提供下列好處。

【坐騎保護】對坐騎進行的攻擊檢定具有劣勢。

【穩固騎手】你不會在違背你意願的情況下被迫離開坐騎。此屬性在你處於&Reference[Incapacitated apply=false]{失能}狀態期間失效。

Wand of Pyrotechnics.name: 煙火魔杖
Wand of Pyrotechnics.description:
魔杖，普通

這根魔杖具有7點充能。持握魔杖期間，你可以採取魔法動作，消耗1充能，在120呎內一處你所能看見的一點創造一陣無害的多彩光芒。這陣光芒伴隨著可在300呎外聽見的劈啪聲。光芒的亮度如同火炬的火焰，但只持續一秒。

【恢復充能】此魔杖每日黎明時恢復1d6 + 1已消耗的充能。若你消耗了魔杖的最後1點充能，擲[[/r 1d20]]。若結果為1，魔杖會迸發出無害的煙火表演並被摧毀。

Enduring Spellbook.description:
奇物，普通

這本法術書及其書頁上所寫的任何內容，都不會被火或水損壞。此外，這本法術書不會隨時間老化。
Enduring Spellbook.name: 不朽法術書

Potion of Climbing.description:
藥水，普通

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你獲得等同於你移動速度的攀爬速度，持續1小時。在這段期間，你在為攀爬而進行的力量（運動）檢定中具有優勢。

這瓶藥水分離成類似岩層條紋的褐色、銀色、灰色三層。搖晃瓶子也無法讓顏色混合。

Foundry 註記

名為攀爬者的主動效果可用於追蹤，但無法自動化其效果。
Potion of Climbing.name: 攀爬藥水

Gem of Seeing.name: 真視寶石

奇物，珍稀（需同調）

這塊寶石具有3點充能。以魔法動作，你可以消耗1點充能。接下來的10分鐘內，你在透過寶石觀察周圍時具有120呎的&Reference[Truesight]{真視}。

Defender.name: Defender

Weapon (Any Melee Weapon), Legendary（需同調）

You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

Ioun Stone of Mastery.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgIounStone0000]{Ioun Stone}

When you take a Magic action to toss an Ioun Stone into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three Ioun Stones orbiting your head at the same time.

As a Utilize action, you can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head. If your Attunement to an Ioun Stone ends while it’s orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

Your Proficiency Bonus increases by 1 while this pale green prism orbits your head.
Ioun Stone of Mastery.name: 艾恩石，精通

Enhanced Mastery: Proficiency Bonus.description: Your Proficiency Bonus increases by 1 while this pale green prism orbits your head.
Enhanced Mastery: Proficiency Bonus.name: Enhanced Mastery: Proficiency Bonus

Ballista.description:
Large Object

Armor Class: 15 Hit Points: 50

Ballista Bolt (Requires Load and Aim). Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 120/480 ft. Hit: 16 (3d10) Piercing damage.

A Ballista is a massive crossbow that fires heavy bolts. Loading a Ballista requires the Utilize action, and aiming it requires another Utilize action. Then a crew member can take the Ballista Bolt action.
Ballista.name: Ballista

Robe of Scintillating Colors.name: 虹光法袍
Robe of Scintillating Colors.description:
奇物，非常珍稀（需同調）

This robe has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While you wear it, you can take a Magic action and expend 1 charge to cause the garment to display a shifting pattern of dazzling hues until the end of your next turn. During this time, the robe sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet, and creatures that can see you have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. Any creature in the Bright Light that can see you when the robe’s power is activated must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Stunned condition until the effect ends.

Foundry Note

The Display Dazzling Hues activity includes a measured template which can be used for tracking the area of Bright Light.

Wand of Paralysis.description:
魔杖，珍稀（需由施法者同調）

這根魔杖具有7點充能。持握魔杖期間，你可以採取魔法動作消耗1點充能，使一道細長的藍色射線從魔杖尖端射向位於你60呎內一名你所能看見的生物。目標必須成功通過一次DC 15的體質豁免，否則陷入&Reference[Paralyzed apply=false]{麻痺}狀態，持續1分鐘。在其每個回合結束時，目標重複此豁免，成功時結束其身上的效應。

【恢復充能】此魔杖每日黎明時恢復1d6 + 1已消耗的充能。若你消耗了魔杖的最後1點充能，擲[[/r 1d20]]。若結果為1，魔杖會化為灰燼並被摧毀。
Wand of Paralysis.name: 麻痺魔杖

Sword of Life Stealing.name: 竊命之劍
Sword of Life Stealing.description:
武器（@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepGlaive0000]{長柄刀}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepGreatsword]{巨劍}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepLongsword0]{長劍}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepRapier0000]{刺劍}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepScimitar00]{彎刀}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepShortsword]{短劍}），珍稀（需同調）

當你以這把魔法武器攻擊一名生物，且攻擊檢定的d20擲出20時，若該目標不是構裝體或不死生物，則額外承受15黯蝕傷害，且你獲得等同於目標所承受黯蝕傷害的臨時生命值。

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgFoundryRefere.JournalEntryPage.Ok4iCgD25ENgoRxE cite=false caption=false classes="hide-in-embed"]

Smoldering Armor.description:
護甲（任意重甲、中甲或輕甲），普通

穿著這件護甲期間，會有一縷縷無害、無味的煙霧從護甲上升起。

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgFoundryRefere.JournalEntryPage.Ok4iCgD25ENgoRxE cite=false caption=false classes="hide-in-embed"]
Smoldering Armor.name: 悶燃護甲

Charm of the Boreal Ball.description: This charm allows you cast the level 3 version of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplIceKnife00]{Ice Knife} spell. Once used, the Charm vanishes.
Charm of the Boreal Ball.name: Charm of the Boreal Ball

Quicksand Pit.name: Quicksand Pit
Quicksand Pit.description:
Nuisance Hazard (Levels 1–4)

Actor: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.dmgQuicksandPit0]{Quicksand Pit}

A quicksand pit is 10 feet deep and covers the ground in a 10-foot square. A creature that enters the area sinks [[/r 1d4 + 1]] feet into the quicksand and has the &Reference[Restrained] condition. At the start of each of the creature’s turns, it sinks another [[/r 1d4]] feet. As long as the creature isn’t completely submerged in quicksand, it can take an action to try to escape, doing so with a successful Strength (Athletics) check (DC 10 plus the number of feet the creature has sunk into the quicksand). A creature that is completely submerged in quicksand has &Reference[Total Cover] and the &Reference[Blinded] condition and risks suffocation.

A creature can pull another creature within its reach out of a quicksand pit by taking an action and succeeding on a Strength (Athletics) check (DC 5 plus the number of feet the creature has sunk into the quicksand).

At Higher Levels. You can scale this hazard for higher levels by making the pit deeper and increasing the number of feet a creature sinks at the start of each of its turns, as shown in the following table.

Levels

Pit Depth

Sinking Rate

5–10

15 feet

[[/r 1d6]] feet

11–16

20 feet

[[/r 1d8]] feet

17–20

30 feet

[[/r 1d10]] feet

Foundry Note

The Escape Check and Pull Another Creature Out activities allows you to enter the number of feet the creature has sunk and will increase the DC automatically.

Rod of Resurrection.description:
Rod, Legendary（需同調）

The rod has 5 charges. While you hold it, you can cast one of the following spells from it: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.feats.Item.phbftHealer00000]{Heal} (expends 1 charge) or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplResurrecti]{Resurrection} (expends 5 charges).

The rod regains 1 expended charge daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll [[/r 1d20]]. On a 1, the rod disappears in a harmless burst of radiance.
Rod of Resurrection.name: Rod of Resurrection

Horn of Valhalla: Condition Immunity.name: Horn of Valhalla: Condition Immunity
Horn of Valhalla: Condition Immunity.description: The spirits look like living, breathing warriors, and they have Immunity to the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] and &Reference[Frightened apply=false] conditions.

Horn of Valhalla.name: Horn of Valhalla
Horn of Valhalla.description:
奇物，珍稀 (Silver or Brass)，非常珍稀(Bronze), or Legendary (Iron)

You can take a Magic action to blow this horn. In response, warrior spirits from the plane of Ysgard appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you. Each spirit uses the Berserker stat block and returns to Ysgard after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 Hit Points. The spirits look like living, breathing warriors, and they have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions. Once you use the horn, it can’t be used again until 7 days have passed.

Four types of Horn of Valhalla are known to exist, each made of a different metal. The horn’s type determines how many spirits it summons, as well as the requirement for its use. The DM chooses the horn’s type or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table.

If you blow the horn without meeting its requirement, the summoned spirits attack you. If you meet the requirement, they are Friendly to you and your allies and follow your commands.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgHornOfValhall rollable]

Goggles of Night.name: 夜視護目鏡
Goggles of Night.description:
奇物，非普通

佩戴這副暗色鏡片期間，你具有60呎的黑暗視覺。若你原本就有黑暗視覺，佩戴護目鏡會使其範圍增加60呎。

Potion of Giant Strength (Storm).description:
藥水，傳說

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你的力量屬性值會在1小時內變為29。巨人的種類決定該屬性值。若你的力量等於或高於該值，這瓶藥水對你無效。

這瓶藥水的透明液體中漂浮著一縷形似巨人指甲的光絲。
Potion of Giant Strength (Storm).name: 風暴巨人之力藥水

Gemstone (5,000 GP).name: Gemstone (5,000 GP)
Gemstone (5,000 GP).description: Gemstones are small, lightweight, and easily secured compared to their same value in coins.

Daern's Instant Fortress.description:
奇物，珍稀（需同調）

你可以採取魔法動作，把這個1吋高的精金小雕像放在地上並說出其命令詞，使其迅速長成一座方形的精金高塔。若塔內空間未被佔據，再說一遍命令詞會使其變回雕像形態。高塔出現時，其佔據的區域內每個生物都會被推到緊鄰高塔外的未佔據空間裡。該區域內未被穿戴或攜帶的物體也會被推出塔外。

高塔長寬各20呎，高30呎，各面牆上都有箭孔，頂端則為城垛。其內部分為兩層，其間由梯子、樓梯或斜坡（由你選擇）連通。該梯子、樓梯或斜坡止於一扇通向屋頂的活板門。高塔生成時，其底層面向你的那一面會出現一扇門。只有你用附贈動作向其下達命令時，此門才會開啟。這扇門免疫敲擊術以及類似的魔法。

魔法保護著高塔，使其無法被推倒。高塔的屋頂、門和每面牆都分別具有AC 20與HP 100，免疫除攻城器械以外所造成的鈍擊、穿刺、揮砍傷害，且對其他所有類型的傷害都具有抗力。將高塔變回雕像形態不會修復其受到的傷害。只有@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWish000000]{祈願術}法術能夠修復高塔（這種用法視為複製一個8環或更低環階的法術）。每次施放祈願術都能讓高塔恢復所有生命值。
Daern's Instant Fortress.name: 戴恩的瞬間要塞

Ring of Three Wishes.name: 三願戒指
Ring of Three Wishes.description:
Ring, Legendary

While wearing this ring, you can expend 1 of its 3 charges to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} from it. The ring becomes nonmagical when you use the last charge.

Staff of Power.name: 威力法杖
Staff of Power.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbafcStaffalsoa]{Staff}，非常珍稀（需由術士、契術師或法師同調）

This staff has 20 charges and can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class, saving throws, and spell attack rolls.

Spells. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

Spell

Charge Cost

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplConeofCold]{Cone of Cold}

5

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFireball00]{Fireball} (level 5 version)

5

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGlobeofInv]{Globe of Invulnerability}

6

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplHoldMonste]{Hold Monster}

5

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplLevitate00]{Levitate}

2

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplLightningB]{Lightning Bolt} (level 5 version)

5

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{Magic Missile}

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplRayofEnfee]{Ray of Enfeeblement}

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWallofForc]{Wall of Force}

Regaining Charges. The staff regains 2d8 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll [[/r 1d20]]. On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls but loses all other properties. On a 20, the staff regains [[/r 1d8 + 2]] charges.

Retributive Strike. You can take a Magic action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid surface. The staff is destroyed and releases its magic in an explosion that fills a 30-foot Emanation originating from itself. You have a 50 percent chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take Force damage equal to 16 times the number of charges in the staff. Each other creature in the area makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to 4 times the number of charges in the staff. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

Poisonous Gas.name: Poisonous Gas
Poisonous Gas.description:
Nuisance Hazard (Levels 1–4)

Actor: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.dmgPoisonousGas0]{Poisonous Gas}

Poisonous gas is usually encountered in an enclosed space, such as a sewer or sealed tomb. The gas fills as much space as it can, up to a maximum of ten 10-foot Cubes. The transparent gas carries a foul odor. The gas is continuously or periodically replenished by some natural or magical source, though a strong wind disperses the gas for 1 minute.

Any creature that enters poisonous gas for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 5 (1d10) Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures in the gas also have Disadvantage on Death Saving Throws.

At Higher Levels. You can scale the hazard for higher levels by increasing the Poison damage and the save DC, as shown in the following table.

Levels

Poison Damage

Save DC

5–10

11 (2d10)

14

11–16

22 (4d10)

16

17–20

55 (10d10)

18

Ear Horn of Hearing.name: 助聽耳角
Ear Horn of Hearing.description:
奇物，普通

舉在你耳邊期間，這支號角會壓制&Reference[Deafened apply=false]{耳聾}狀態對你的影響。

Rope of Entanglement.description:
奇物，珍稀

這根繩索長30呎。當你持握這根繩索的一端時，你可以採取魔法動作命令其另一端向前疾衝並纏住位於你20呎內一名你所能看見的生物。目標必須成功通過一次DC 15的敏捷豁免，否則陷入&Reference[Restrained apply=false]{束縛}狀態。你可以透過鬆開你所持握的繩索一端（使繩索盤繞著掉落在目標的空間），或採取附贈動作重複命令（使繩索回到你手中並盤繞起來）來釋放目標。

一個被繩索束縛的目標可以採取動作，自行選擇進行一次DC 15的力量（運動）或敏捷（特技）檢定。若檢定成功，目標不再被繩索束縛。若目標逃脫時你仍然持握著繩索，則你可以採取反應命令繩索回到你手中並盤繞起來；否則，繩索會盤繞著掉落在目標的空間中。

該繩索AC 20、HP 20，並具有對毒素與心靈傷害的免疫。只要繩索還剩至少1點生命值，其就能每5分鐘恢復1點生命值。若繩索的生命值降至0，則其被摧毀。

Foundry 註記

該物品附有20次使用次數，用於追蹤其HP。損傷繩索行動可用於施加傷害，修復繩索行動可用於恢復其HP。

脫逃行動可用於將運動與敏捷檢定傳送到聊天室，供目標擲骰以嘗試脫逃。
Rope of Entanglement.name: 糾纏繩

Grenade, Fragmentation.name: Grenade, Fragmentation
Grenade, Fragmentation.description:
As an action, you can throw a grenade at a point up to 60 feet away. The grenade explodes at that point, creating a particular effect in a 20-foot-radius Sphere.

Each creature in the Sphere makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Executioner's Axe.description:
Weapon (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepBattleaxe0]{Battleaxe}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepGreataxe00]{Greataxe}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepHalberd000]{Halberd}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepHandaxe000]{Handaxe})，非常珍稀

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

Any Humanoid you hit with the weapon takes an extra 2d6 Slashing damage, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the extra damage dealt.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgFoundryRefere.JournalEntryPage.Ok4iCgD25ENgoRxE cite=false caption=false classes="hide-in-embed"]
Executioner's Axe.name: Executioner's Axe

Cap of Water Breathing.description:
奇物，非普通

在水下穿戴這頂帽子期間，你可以採取魔法動作，在你的頭部周圍創造一個空氣泡。這個氣泡讓你能在水下正常呼吸。直到你摘下帽子或不再位於水下前，氣泡都會跟隨著你。
Cap of Water Breathing.name: 水下呼吸帽

Air Bubble.description: 這個氣泡讓你能在水下正常呼吸。直到你摘下帽子或不再位於水下前，氣泡都會跟隨著你。
Air Bubble.name: 空氣泡

Mithral Armor.description:
護甲（除生皮甲外，任意中甲或重甲），非普通

秘銀是一種輕盈且柔韌的金屬。以秘銀製成的護甲可以穿在普通衣物裡面。若這套護甲通常會使敏捷（隱匿）檢定具有劣勢，或有力量要求，則其秘銀版本不具有這些限制。

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgFoundryRefere.JournalEntryPage.Ok4iCgD25ENgoRxE cite=false caption=false classes="hide-in-embed"]
Mithral Armor.name: 秘銀護甲

Manual of Bodily Health.name: 強身健體手冊
Manual of Bodily Health.description:
奇物，非常珍稀

This book contains health and nutrition tips, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book’s contents and practicing its guidelines, your Constitution increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic but regains it in a century.

Foundry Note

This item includes 48 max uses for tracking hours read.

The Read activity includes a scaling value that lets you enter the amount of hours you've read. Once you hit 48 you can use the included Active Effect to increase your Constitution.

The Reset Progress activity resets your uses to 0 if you fail to complete the book within 6 days and need to start over.

Veteran's Cane.name: 老兵手杖
Veteran's Cane.description:
奇物，普通

你可以採取附贈動作，將這根手杖變成一把普通的長劍，或將長劍變回手杖。無論哪種情況，你都必須握著該物品。

Charm of Darkvision.name: Charm of Darkvision
Charm of Darkvision.description:
超自然贈禮（護咒）

This Charm allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDarkvision]{Darkvision}. Once used three times, the Charm vanishes from you.

Instrument of Illusions.description:
奇物，普通

演奏這件樂器期間，你可以採取魔法動作，在以該樂器為源頭的5呎發散區域內創造無害的幻象視覺效應。若你是吟遊詩人，發散區域的大小提升為15呎。範例視覺效應包括發光的音符、幽靈般的舞者、蝴蝶，以及輕柔飄落的雪花。這些魔法效應既無實體也無聲音，且明顯是幻象。你停止演奏時，效應隨之結束。
Instrument of Illusions.name: 幻象樂器

Winged.name: 飛翼
Winged.description: 翅膀持續1小時，或直到你以魔法動作提前結束此效應。翅膀使你獲得60呎的飛行速度。

Wings of Flying.name: 飛行之翼
Wings of Flying.description:
奇物，珍稀（需同調）

穿戴這件斗篷期間，你可以採取魔法動作將斗篷變成你背上的一對翅膀。翅膀持續1小時，或直到你以魔法動作提前結束此效應。翅膀使你獲得60呎的飛行速度。若翅膀消失時你身在空中，你會墜落。翅膀消失後，你在[[/r 1d12]]小時內無法再次使用。

Rope of Mending.description:
奇物，普通

這捆50呎長的繩索被切成任意數量的較小段後，都能自行修復。你可以採取魔法動作，使所有相互接觸且未用於其他方式的繩段重新編接在一起。若其中一段遺失或被毀壞，縫接繩的長度將永遠縮短。
Rope of Mending.name: 縫接繩

Vecna's Hand: Alignment, Strength.name: Vecna's Hand: Alignment, Strength
Vecna's Hand: Alignment, Strength.description: While you are attuned to the hand, your alignment is Neutral Evil, and your Strength becomes 20 unless it is already 20 or higher.

Icy Touch: Bonus Damage.name: Icy Touch: Bonus Damage
Icy Touch: Bonus Damage.description: Any melee spell attack you make with the hand and any melee attack made with a weapon held by it deals an extra 2d8 Cold damage on a hit.

Hand of Vecna.description:
奇物, Artifact（需同調）

The Eye of Vecna and the Hand of Vecna are separate Artifacts that might be found together or separately. The hand is a shriveled left extremity. See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgEyeAndHandOfV]{Eye and Hand of Vecna} if both Artifacts are obtained.

Random Properties of the Hand. The Hand of Vecna has the following @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgMagicItems000.JournalEntryPage.iA3mHmvlXvWKlyBo#artifact-properties]{random properties}:

  • 1 @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgMinorBenefici]{minor beneficial property}
  • 1 @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgMajorBenefici]{major beneficial property}
  • 1 @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgMinorDetrimen]{minor detrimental property}

Attuning to the Hand. To attune to the hand, you must press it against the stump where your left hand was. The hand grafts itself to your arm and becomes a functioning appendage. If the hand is ever removed, you die.

Properties of the Hand. When you are attuned to the hand, your alignment is Neutral Evil, and you gain the following benefits:

Great Strength.

Your Strength becomes 20 unless it is already 20 or higher.

Icy Touch.

Any melee spell attack you make with the hand and any melee attack made with a weapon held by it deals an extra 2d8 Cold damage on a hit.

Spellcasting.

The hand has 8 charges and regains 1d4 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. You can cast a spell on the Hand of Vecna Spells table from the hand (save DC 18). The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell. Each time you cast a spell from it, the hand casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSuggestion]{Suggestion} on you ([[/save ability=wis dc=18]]{save DC 18}; no Concentration required), demanding that you commit an evil act. The hand might have a specific act in mind or leave it up to you.

Blackrazor.name: Blackrazor
Blackrazor.description:
Weapon (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepGreatsword]{Greatsword}), Artifact（需同調）

Hidden in the dungeon of White Plume Mountain, Blackrazor shines like a piece of night sky filled with stars. Its black scabbard is decorated with pieces of cut obsidian.

You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. If you hit an Undead with this weapon, you take [[/damage 1d10 type=necrotic]] damage, and the target regains [[/healing 1d10 type=healing]]{1d10} Hit Points. If this Necrotic damage reduces you to 0 Hit Points, Blackrazor devours your soul (see “Devour Soul” below).

While you hold this weapon, you have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions, and you have Blindsight with a range of 30 feet.

Devour Soul.

Whenever you use Blackrazor to reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points, the sword slays the creature and devours its soul unless it is a Construct or an Undead. A creature whose soul has been devoured by Blackrazor can be restored to life only by a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} spell.

When Blackrazor devours a soul that isn’t yours, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the slain creature’s Hit Point maximum.

Haste.

Blackrazor can cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplHaste00000]{Haste} on you, after which it can’t cast this spell again until the next dawn. Blackrazor decides when to cast the spell, which takes effect at the start of your turn. The spell lasts for 1 minute (no Concentration required) or until Blackrazor decides to end it, which it can do at the end of any of your turns.

Sentience.

Blackrazor is a sentient Chaotic Neutral weapon with an [[/r 1d20 + 3#Intelligence]]{Intelligence of 17}, a [[/roll 1d20 + 0#Wisdom]]{Wisdom of 10}, and a [[/roll 1d20 + 4#Charisma]]{Charisma of 19}. It has hearing and Darkvision out to 120 feet.

The weapon speaks Common and can communicate with its wielder telepathically. Its voice is deep and echoing. While you are attuned to it, Blackrazor also understands every language you know.

Personality.

Blackrazor speaks with an imperious tone, as though accustomed to being obeyed.

The sword’s purpose is to consume souls. It doesn’t care whose souls it eats, including the wielder’s. The sword believes that all matter and energy sprang from a void of negative energy and will one day return to it. Blackrazor is meant to hurry that process along.

Despite its nihilism, Blackrazor feels a strange kinship to Wave and Whelm, two other weapons locked away under White Plume Mountain. It wants the three weapons to be reunited and wielded together in combat, even though it violently disagrees with Whelm and finds Wave tedious.

Blackrazor’s hunger for souls must be regularly fed. If the sword goes 3 days or more without consuming a soul, a conflict between it and its wielder occurs at the next sunset.

Destroying Blackrazor.

Blackrazor can be destroyed by crushing it in the great gears of Mechanus. Primus, the creator of the modrons, also knows a series of musical tones that Blackrazor can’t stand to hear, causing the sword to shatter.

Belt of Dwarvenkind.name: 矮人腰帶
Belt of Dwarvenkind.description:
奇物，珍稀（需同調）

穿戴這條腰帶期間，你獲得下列好處。

【矮人語】你知曉矮人語。

【矮人之友】你與矮人和灰矮人互動所進行的魅力（說服）檢定具有優勢。

【堅韌】你的體質提升2點，上限為20。

此外，與腰帶同調期間，你每天黎明時有50%的機率長出一大把鬍鬚（若你能長鬍鬚）；或者若你已有鬍鬚，則會變得更濃密。

若你不是矮人或灰矮人，穿戴這條腰帶期間，你還會獲得下列額外好處。

【黑暗視覺】你具有60呎的黑暗視覺。

【堅毅】你具有對毒素傷害的抗力。你在為避免或結束中毒狀態而進行的豁免中也具有優勢。

奇物，非常見（+1）、珍稀（+2）、非常珍稀（+3）

While wearing these wraps, you have a bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with your Unarmed Strikes. The bonus is determined by the wraps’ rarity, and those strikes deal your choice of Force damage or their normal damage type.

Clockwork Amulet.name: 發條護符
Clockwork Amulet.description:
奇物，普通

這枚銅製護符內有微小的咬合齒輪，由機械境（一個秩序井然、萬物皆可預測的位面）的魔法所驅動。護符內隱約傳出滴答與嗡嗡聲。

佩戴此護符期間，當你進行攻擊檢定時，你可以放棄擲d20，改為直接將骰值視為10。此屬性一旦使用，直到下個黎明前無法再次使用。

Rod of Security.description:
Rod，非常珍稀

While holding this rod, you can take a Magic action to activate it. The rod then instantly transports you and up to 199 other willing creatures you can see to a demiplane. You choose the form the demiplane takes. It could be a tranquil garden, a cheery tavern, an immense palace, a tropical island, a fantastic carnival, or whatever else you can imagine. Regardless of its nature, the demiplane contains enough water and food to sustain its visitors, and the demiplane's environment can't harm its occupants. Everything else that can be interacted with there can exist only there. For example, a flower picked from a garden there disappears if it is taken outside the demiplane.

For each hour spent in the demiplane, a visitor regains Hit Points as if it had spent 1 Hit Point Die. Also, creatures don't age while there, although time passes normally. Visitors can remain there for up to 200 days divided by the number of creatures present (round down).

When the time runs out or you take a Magic action to end the effect, all visitors reappear in the location they occupied when you activated the rod or an unoccupied space nearest that location. Once used, this property can't be used again until 10 days have passed.

Foundry Note

The Transport to Demiplane activity will consume a use of this item but the ten day recovery period must be tracked manually.

Adamantine Armor.description:
護甲（除皮甲外，任意中甲或重甲），非普通

這套護甲使用了一種現存最堅硬的物質——精金加以強化。穿戴該護甲時，任何命中你的&Reference[CriticalHits]{暴擊}都會改為普通命中。

Tome of the Stilled Tongue.name: Tome of the Stilled Tongue
Tome of the Stilled Tongue.description:
奇物, Legendary (Requires Attunement by a Wizard)

This book has a desiccated tongue pinned to its front cover. Five of these tomes exist, and it’s unknown which one is the original. The tongue on the first Tome of the Stilled Tongue belonged to a treacherous former servant of the lich Vecna. The tongues pinned to the covers of the four copies came from other spellcasters who crossed Vecna. The first few pages of each tome are filled with indecipherable scrawls. The remaining pages are blank.

While attuned to this item, you can use it as a Spellbook and an Arcane Focus. In addition, while holding the tome, you can take a Bonus Action to cast a spell you have written in this tome, without expending a spell slot or using any Verbal or Somatic components. Once used, this property of the tome can’t be used again until the next dawn.

Only you can remove the tongue from the book’s cover. If you do so, all spells written in the book are permanently erased.

Vecna watches anyone using this tome and can write cryptic messages in it. These messages typically fade away after they are read.

Foundry Note

The Cast Spell activity can be used for tracking your uses of that property.

Wand of Magic Detection.name: 偵測魔法魔杖
Wand of Magic Detection.description:
魔杖，非普通

這根魔杖具有3點充能。持握魔杖期間，你可以消耗1點充能，透過魔杖施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{偵測魔法}。此魔杖每日黎明時恢復1d3已消耗的充能。

Dimensional Shackles.name: 次元鐐銬

Dimensionally Bound.description:
鐐銬會阻止被其約束的生物進行異次元移動，包括傳送和異位面旅行。不過鐐銬並不能阻止生物穿過一道連接異位面的傳送門。

每隔30日，被約束的生物可以進行一次[[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=30 format=long]]。若檢定成功，該生物會掙脫並破壞鐐銬。
Dimensionally Bound.name: 次元束縛

Place Shackles.name: 戴上鐐銬
Place Shackles.target: 處於失能狀態的小型到大型生物

Dimensional Shackles.description:
奇物，珍稀

你可以採取利用動作，將這副鐐銬戴在一個處於&Reference[Incapacitated apply=false]{失能}狀態的生物身上。鐐銬可以自行調整，以適應小型到大型體型的生物。次元鐐銬能夠阻止被其約束的生物進行異次元移動，包括傳送和異位面旅行。不過鐐銬並不能阻止生物穿過一道連接異位面的傳送門。

你以及你在使用鐐銬時所指定的任何生物，都可以採取利用動作將鐐銬解除。每隔30日，被約束的生物可以進行一次[[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=30 format=long]]。若檢定成功，該生物會掙脫並破壞鐐銬。

Ioun Stone of Agility.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgIounStone0000]{Ioun Stone}

When you take a Magic action to toss an Ioun Stone into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three Ioun Stones orbiting your head at the same time.

As a Utilize action, you can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head. If your Attunement to an Ioun Stone ends while it’s orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

Your Dexterity increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this deep-red sphere orbits your head.

This serpentine statuette of an owl can become a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.VVXly3ue0i3YgGrB]{Giant Owl} for up to 8 hours. The owl can communicate telepathically with you at any range if you and it are on the same plane of existence. Once it has been used, it can’t be used again until 2 days have passed.

Foundry Note

Hidden Pit.name: Hidden Pit
Hidden Pit.description:
Nuisance Trap (Levels 1–4)

Trigger: A creature moves onto the pit’s lid

Duration: Instantaneous

This 10-foot-deep pit has a hinged lid constructed from material identical to the surrounding floor. When a creature moves onto the lid, it swings open like a trapdoor, causing the creature to fall into the pit. The lid remains open thereafter.

A creature that falls into the pit takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage from the fall.

Detect and Disarm. As a Study action, a creature can examine the section of floor that forms the pit’s lid and make a [[/check inv 15]] check, detecting the pit on a successful check. Once the pit is detected, an Iron Spike or a similar object can be wedged between the pit’s lid and the surrounding floor to prevent the lid from opening, thereby making it safe to cross. The cover can also be held shut using Arcane Lock or similar magic.

Escape. A creature needs a Climb Speed, climbing gear, or magic such as Spider Climb to scale the pit’s smooth walls. You can make the pit easier to escape by adding cracks in the walls big enough to serve as handholds and footholds.

At Higher Levels. You can scale the trap for higher levels by increasing the pit’s depth and damage, as shown in the following table.

Wave.name: Wave
Wave.description:
Weapon (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepTrident000]{Trident}), Artifact（需同調）

You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack roll with this weapon, the target takes an extra 21 Necrotic damage.

While holding Wave, you gain the following benefits:

Combat Ready. You have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

Underwater Adaptation. A bubble of air forms around your head while you are underwater, allowing you to breathe normally in that environment.

Aquatic Command. Wave has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While you carry it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Dominate Beast (save DC 20) from it on a Beast that has a Swim Speed.

Globe of Invulnerability. While holding Wave, you can cast the level 9 version of Globe of Invulnerability from it. Once used, this property can’t be used again until the next dawn.

Sentience/Personality/Lore Details

Held in the dungeon of White Plume Mountain, Wave is engraved with images of waves, shells, and sea creatures.

Sentience. Wave is a sentient weapon of Neutral alignment, with an Intelligence of 14, a Wisdom of 10, and a Charisma of 18. It has hearing and Darkvision out to 120 feet.

The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and speaks Aquan.

Personality. Wave zealously encourages mortals to worship sea gods and has a habit of humming sea chanteys. Conflict arises if the wielder fails to further the weapon’s objectives in the world.

Destroying Wave. Wave can be destroyed only on the island of Thunderforge, where it was forged. The weapon must be melted down by a storm giant or someone imbued with a storm giant’s strength. Destroying Wave angers a god of the sea, who sends powerful agents to attack the island and punish the destroyers.

超自然贈禮（護咒）

One weapon in your possession becomes a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgDragonSlayer0]{Dragon Slayer} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgGiantSlayer00]{Giant Slayer} (DM’s choice) for the next 9 days. Crystal Ball of Telepathy.description:
奇物, Legendary（需同調）

While touching this crystal orb, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplScrying000]{Scrying} (save DC 17) with it. In addition, you can communicate telepathically with creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell’s sensor. You can also cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSuggestion]{Suggestion} (save DC 17) through the sensor on one of those creatures. You don’t need to concentrate on this Suggestion to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if Scrying ends. You can’t cast Suggestion in this way again until the next dawn.

Sylvan Talon.name: 木族利爪
Sylvan Talon.description:
武器（@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepDagger0000]{匕首}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepRapier0000]{刺劍}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepScimitar00]{彎刀}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepShortsword]{短劍}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepSickle0000]{鐮刀}或@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepSpear00000]{矛}），普通（需同調）

這把武器在你身上期間，你能理解所有精類的非書面溝通，而牠們也能理解你的非書面溝通。

【密語】你可以採取魔法動作，用這把武器施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplMessage000]{傳訊術}。此屬性一旦使用，直到下個黎明前無法再次使用。

Water Ring of Elemental Command.description:
Ring, Legendary（需同調）

Each Ring of Elemental Command is linked to one of the four Elemental Planes. The DM chooses or randomly determines the linked plane. For example, a Ring of Elemental Command (air) is linked to the Elemental Plane of Air.

Every Ring of Elemental Command has the following two properties:

Elemental Bane. While wearing the ring, you have Advantage on attack rolls against Elementals and they have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

Elemental Compulsion. While wearing the ring, you can take a Magic action to try to compel an Elemental you see within 60 feet of yourself. The Elemental makes a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the Elemental has the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition until the start your next turn, and you determine what it does with its move and action on its next turn.

Elemental Focus. While wearing the ring, you benefit from additional properties corresponding to the ring’s linked Elemental Plane:

Water. You know Aquan, you gain a Swim Speed of 60 feet, and you can breathe underwater.

Spellcasting. The ring has 5 charges and regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can cast a spell from it. Choose the spell from the list of available spells based on the Elemental Plane the ring is linked to, as shown in the following table. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell, which has a save DC of 18.

Plane

Spells (Charges)

Water

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplCreateorDe]{Create or Destroy Water} (1 charge), @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplIceStorm00]{Ice Storm} (2 charges), @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplTsunami000]{Tsunami} (5 charges), @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWallofIce0]{Wall of Ice} (3 charges), @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWaterWalk0]{Water Walk} (2 charges)

Horn of Silent Alarm.description:
奇物，普通

此號角具有4點充能，並在每日黎明時恢復1d4已消耗的充能。以一個魔法動作，你可以吹響號角並消耗1充能。位於號角600呎內、你所選擇的一名生物會聽見號角的嘹亮聲響。其他生物都聽不見。

藥水，非普通

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你的力量屬性值會在1小時內變為21。巨人的種類決定該屬性值。若你的力量等於或高於該值，這瓶藥水對你無效。

Large Object

Toxic Keg (Requires Load and Aim). Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point 30 to 300 feet from the launcher. Failure: 14 (4d6) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.

A back-mounted, wooden catapult flings small kegs of toxic gas. Loading a Keg Launcher requires the Utilize action, and aiming it requires another Utilize action. Then a crew member can take the Toxic Keg action.

Iron Flask.description:
奇物, Legendary

While holding this brass-stoppered iron flask, you can take a Magic action to target a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. If the flask is empty and the target is native to a plane of existence other than the one you’re on, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be trapped in the flask. If the target has been trapped by the flask before, it has Advantage on the save. Once trapped, a creature remains in the flask until released. The flask can hold only one creature at a time. A creature trapped in the flask doesn’t age and doesn’t need to breathe, eat, or drink.

You can take a Magic action to remove the flask’s stopper and release the creature in the flask. The creature then obeys your commands for 1 hour, understanding those commands even if it doesn’t know the language in which the commands are given. If you issue no commands or give the creature a command that is likely to result in its death or imprisonment, it defends itself but otherwise takes no actions. At the end of the duration, the creature acts in accordance with its normal disposition and alignment.

An @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplIdentify00]{Identify} spell reveals if the flask contains a creature, but the only way to determine the type of creature is to open the flask. A newly discovered Iron Flask might already contain a creature chosen by the DM or determined randomly by rolling on the following table (see the Monster Manual for the creature’s stat block).

Possible Creatures Roll Table

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgIronFlaskCont caption=false rollable]

Foundry Note

This item has one limited use for tracking whether or not a creature has been trapped in the flask.

The Add Trapped Creature activity expends a usage to indicate it is currently full.

The Release Trapped Creature activity is a summon activity which restores a usage to indicate it can now contain another creature. You can edit the activity, change to the "Summon" tab and drag the captured creature's Actor onto the tab so it can be summoned later.
Iron Flask.name: 收妖瓶

Manual of Quickness of Action.name: 迅捷行動手冊
Manual of Quickness of Action.description:
奇物，非常珍稀

This book contains coordination and balance exercises, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book’s contents and practicing its guidelines, your Dexterity increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic but regains it in a century.

Foundry Note

This item includes 48 max uses for tracking hours read.

The Read activity includes a scaling value that lets you enter the amount of hours you've read. Once you hit 48 you can use the included Active Effect to increase your Dexterity.

The Reset Progress activity resets your uses to 0 if you fail to complete the book within 6 days and need to start over.

Tome of Leadership and Influence.name: 統御影響卷冊
Tome of Leadership and Influence.description:
奇物，非常珍稀

This book contains guidelines for influencing and charming others, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book’s contents and practicing its guidelines, your Charisma increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic but regains it in a century.

Foundry Note

This item includes 48 max uses for tracking hours read.

The Read activity includes a scaling value that lets you enter the amount of hours you've read. Once you hit 48 you can use the included Active Effect to increase your Charisma.

The Reset Progress activity resets your uses to 0 if you fail to complete the book within 6 days and need to start over.

Tan Bag of Tricks.description:
奇物，非普通

這種布袋有三種不同顏色的版本：灰色、鐵鏽色、棕褐色。布袋看起來空無一物，但把手伸進去會摸到一個小小的毛絨物體。

你可以採取魔法動作取出布袋裡的毛絨物體，並將其扔出至多20呎遠。當物體落地時，投骰參考對應顏色布袋的表格決定物體變成的生物。該生物的數值面板見《怪物圖鑑》。該生物在下個黎明時分或其生命值降至0時消失。

該生物對你和你的盟友態度友好，並緊接在你的先攻順位後行動。你可以採取附贈動作命令該生物在其下個回合如何移動、採取什麼動作，例如攻擊你的敵人。沒接到命令時，該生物會依其本性行動。

一旦袋子抽出三件毛絨物體後，直到下個黎明前都無法再次使用。

Rolling Stone.name: Rolling Stone
Rolling Stone.description:
Deadly Trap (Levels 11–16) or Nuisance Trap (Levels 17–20)

Trigger: A creature moves onto a pressure plate

Duration: Until the stone stops rolling

When a creature moves onto a hidden pressure plate, a 5-foot-radius orb of solid stone is released from a secret compartment and begins to roll. The stone and all creatures nearby roll Initiative; the stone gets a [[/r 1d20 + 8]]{+8} bonus on its Initiative roll.

On its turn, the stone moves 60 feet in one direction, changing course if redirected by an obstacle. The stone can move through creatures’ spaces, and creatures can move through the stone’s space, treating it as &Reference[Difficult Terrain]. Whenever the stone enters a creature’s space for the first time on a turn or a creature enters the stone’s space while the stone is rolling, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 55 (10d10) Bludgeoning damage and have the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.

The stone stops when it hits a wall or similar barrier. It can’t go around corners, but creative dungeon builders incorporate curving turns into nearby passages that allow the stone to keep moving.

Detect and Disarm. As a Study action, a creature can examine the section of floor that forms the pressure plate and make a [[/check inv 15]] check, deducing the pressure plate’s function on a successful check. Wedging an Iron Spike or a similar object under the pressure plate prevents the trap from triggering.

Destroy the Stone. The stone is a Large object that has AC 17, HP 100, a Damage Threshold of 10, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.

Slow the Stone. As an action, a creature can try to slow down the stone with a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. If the check is successful, the distance the stone moves on its turn is reduced by 15 feet. If that distance drops to 0, it stops moving and is no longer a threat.

Bead of Nourishment.description:
奇物，普通

這顆無味的凝膠珠會在你的舌頭上溶解，提供相當於1天@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagRations0000]{口糧}的營養。

Trident of Fish Command.description:
武器（@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepTrident000]{三叉戟}），非普通（需同調）

這把魔法武器具有3點充能，並在每日黎明時恢復1d3點已消耗的充能。攜帶這把武器期間，你可以消耗1點充能，透過武器對一隻具有游泳速度的野獸施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDominateBe]{支配野獸}法術（豁免DC 15）。

Saving Throw Bonus.description: While the weapon is on your person, you also gain a +1 bonus to saving throws.

Luck Blade.name: Luck Blade
Luck Blade.description:
Weapon (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepGlaive0000]{Glaive}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepGreatsword]{Greatsword}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepLongsword0]{Longsword}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepRapier0000]{Rapier}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepScimitar00]{Scimitar}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepSickle0000]{Sickle}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepShortsword]{Shortsword}), Legendary（需同調）

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While the weapon is on your person, you also gain a +1 bonus to saving throws.

Luck. If the weapon is on your person, you can call on its luck (no action required) to reroll one failed D20 Test if you don’t have the Incapacitated condition. You must use the second roll. Once used, this property can’t be used again until the next dawn.

Wish. The weapon has [[/r 1d3#Initial Charges]] charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge and cast Wish from it. Once used, this property can’t be used again until the next dawn. The weapon loses this property if it has no charges.

Ring of Spell Turning.name: 法術反轉戒指
Ring of Spell Turning.description:
Ring, Legendary（需同調）

While wearing this ring, you have Advantage on saving throws against spells. If you succeed on the save for a spell of level 7 or lower, the spell has no effect on you. If that spell targeted only you and didn’t create an area of effect, you can take a Reaction to deflect the spell back at the spell’s caster; the caster must make a saving throw against the spell using their own spell save DC.

Rod of Alertness.name: 警示權杖
Rod of Alertness.description:
Rod，非常珍稀（需同調）

This rod has the following properties.

Alertness. While holding the rod, you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on Initiative rolls.

Spells. While holding the rod, you can cast the following spells from it: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.Mzh95utKDPIrjiH8]{Detect Evil and Good}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDetectPois]{Detect Poison and Disease}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSeeInvisib]{See Invisibility}.

Protective Aura. As a Magic action, you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground, whereupon the rod’s head sheds Bright Light in a 60-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 60 feet. While in that Bright Light, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws and can sense the location of any Invisible creature that is also in the Bright Light.

The rod’s head stops glowing and the effect ends after 10 minutes or when a creature takes a Magic action to pull the rod from the ground. Once used, this property can’t be used again until the next dawn.

Foundry Note

The Plant Rod activity can be used to place a 60 foot template representing the Bright Light radius. It includes an Active Effect which can be applied to the relevant Actors and adds the +1 bonus to AC and Saving Throws.

Bead of Force.description:
奇物，珍稀

這個小型黑色球體直徑3/4吋，重1盎司。被發現時通常會有[[/r 1d4 + 4#Beads of Force]]顆力場珠放在一起。

你可以採取魔法動作把珠子扔出至多60呎遠。珠子在落點處引發爆炸並因此被摧毀，其周圍半徑10呎的球形區域內每個生物必須成功通過一次DC 15的敏捷豁免，否則承受5d4力場傷害。此外，一個隱形的球形力場會封閉該區域1分鐘。任何豁免失敗且完全處於範圍中的生物會被困在這個球體裡面。豁免成功或部分處於範圍中的生物會沿著遠離球體中心的方向被推出範圍。只有空氣能穿過力場障壁，任何攻擊或其他效應皆無法穿過。

被困在內部的生物可以採取利用動作推動力場障壁，使球體移動至多相當於該生物速度一半的距離。該球體可以被拿起，且無論內部生物的重量為何，力場珠整體都只重1磅。
Bead of Force.name: 力場珠

Source: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgDmtDonjon0000]{Donjon}

You remain imprisoned until you are found and removed from the sphere. You can’t be located by any Divination magic, but a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} spell can reveal the location of your prison.

Donjon.name: Donjon

Card Effect.name: Card Effect
Card Effect.condition: Card's effect occurs immediately upon draw

Donjon.description: You disappear and become entombed in a state of suspended animation in an extradimensional sphere. Everything you’re wearing and carrying disappears with you except for Artifacts, which stay behind in the space you occupied when you disappeared. You remain imprisoned until you are found and removed from the sphere. You can’t be located by any Divination magic, but a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} spell can reveal the location of your prison. You draw no more cards.

Rival Coin.description:
奇物，普通

這枚金幣的兩面各壓印著一個生物。這兩個圖像中的生物必須是彼此有名的對手或敵人。例如，一枚勁敵硬幣可能一面是伊格薇爾，另一面是魔鄧肯；或者一面是文傑，另一面是提亞馬特。其中一個人物位於硬幣的「正面」，另一個位於「反面」。

這枚硬幣具有1充能，並在每日黎明時恢復已消耗的充能。你可以採取魔法動作拋擲這枚硬幣，並消耗其充能。擲任意一顆骰子（[[/r 1d2]]）來判定硬幣是正面朝上（結果為偶數）還是反面朝上（結果為奇數）。該擲骰結果也決定效應：

【正面】以位於你60呎內一名你所能看見的生物為目標。目標進行一次DC 13的感知豁免。豁免失敗時，目標受到2d4心靈傷害，且在其下個回合結束前所進行的下一次攻擊檢定具有劣勢；豁免成功時，目標僅承受半數傷害。

【反面】你受到1d4心靈傷害。
Rival Coin.name: 勁敵硬幣

Sending Stones.name: 傳訊石
Sending Stones.description:
奇物，非普通

傳訊石兩顆一對，這兩塊石頭經過雕刻而相互匹配，因此兩塊石頭的配對非常容易辨認。觸摸其中一塊石頭期間，你可以用該石頭施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSending000]{短訊術}，目標為另一塊石頭的攜帶者。若沒有任何生物攜帶另一塊石頭，則你在使用該石頭時會得知這一情況，而你不會施放該法術。

一旦使用其中任一塊石頭施放了短訊術，則兩塊石頭直到下個黎明前都無法再次使用。若一對石頭中的一塊被摧毀，則另一塊石頭會失去其魔法。

Staff of Frost.name: 冰霜法杖
Staff of Frost.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbafcStaffalsoa]{Staff}，非常珍稀(Requires Attunement by a Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard)

You have Resistance to Cold damage while you hold this staff.

Spells. The staff has 10 charges. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.
