Copying a Scroll into a Spellbook. A Wizard spell on a Spell Scroll can be copied into a spellbook. When a spell is copied in this way, the copier must succeed on an Intelligence (Arcana) check with a DC equal to 10 plus the spell’s level. On a successful check, the spell is copied. Whether the check succeeds or fails, the Spell Scroll is destroyed.
Spell Scroll.name: Spell Scroll

Helm of Telepathy.name: 心靈感應頭盔
Helm of Telepathy.description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

穿戴這頂頭盔期間，你具有30呎的心靈感應，且你可以透過頭盔施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDetectThou]{偵測思想}或@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSuggestion]{暗示術}（豁免DC 13）。一旦透過頭盔施放其中任一法術，直到下個黎明前，你都無法再次透過頭盔施放該法術。

Spider Movement and Resistance.name: Spider Movement and Resistance
Spider Movement and Resistance.description:
Poison Resistance. You have Resistance to Poison damage.

Spider Climb. You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed and can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.

Spider Walk. You can’t be caught in webs of any sort and can move through webs as if they were Difficult Terrain.

Cloak of Arachnida.description:
奇物，非常珍稀（需同調）

This fine garment is made of black silk interwoven with faint, silvery threads. While wearing it, you gain the following benefits.

Poison Resistance. You have Resistance to Poison damage.

Spider Climb. You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed and can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.

Spider Walk. You can’t be caught in webs of any sort and can move through webs as if they were Difficult Terrain.

Web. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWeb0000000]{Web} (save DC 13). The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area. Once used, this property can’t be used again until the next dawn.
Cloak of Arachnida.name: 節肢斗篷

Comet Card: Death Save Advantage.name: Comet Card: Death Save Advantage
Comet Card: Death Save Advantage.description:
Source: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgDmtComet00000]{Comet}

You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws for 1 year.

Comet Card: Marked Foe.name: Comet Card: Marked Foe
Comet Card: Marked Foe.description: If you reduce your foe to 0 Hit Points during that combat, you have Advantage on Death Saving Throws for 1 year.

Comet.name: Comet

Card Effect: Start.condition: The next time you enter combat against one or more Hostile creatures
Card Effect: Start.name: Card Effect: Start

Card Effect: Resolve.condition: when the selected Hostile creature dies during this combat
Card Effect: Resolve.name: Card Effect: Resolve

Comet.description: The next time you enter combat against one or more Hostile creatures, you can select one of them as your foe when you roll Initiative. If you reduce your foe to 0 Hit Points during that combat, you have Advantage on Death Saving Throws for 1 year. If someone else reduces your chosen foe to 0 Hit Points or you don’t choose a foe, this card has no effect.

Adamantine Ammunition.description:
武器（任意彈藥或近戰武器），非普通

構成這枚彈藥的材料乃是精金——世界上最堅硬的物質。每當這枚彈藥命中物件時，其命中均為 &Reference[criticalhits]{暴擊}。

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgFoundryRefere.JournalEntryPage.Ok4iCgD25ENgoRxE cite=false caption=false classes="hide-in-embed"]
Adamantine Ammunition.name: 精金彈藥

Staff of Swarming Insects.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbafcStaffalsoa]{法杖}，珍稀（需由吟遊詩人、牧師、德魯伊、術士、契術師或法師同調）

這根法杖具有10點充能。

【蟲雲】持握法杖期間，你可以採取魔法動作消耗1點充能，使一群無害的飛蟲充滿你自身30呎的發散區域。這些昆蟲持續存在10分鐘，使該區域對你以外的生物而言成為&Reference[Heavily Obscured]{重度遮蔽}區域。強風（例如@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGustofWind]{造風術}所創造的風）會驅散蟲群並結束此效應。

【法術】持握法杖期間，你可以透過法杖施放下表中的一道法術，使用你的法術豁免DC與法術攻擊調整值。下表列出施放各法術所需消耗的充能。

法術

充能消耗

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGiantInsec]{巨蟲術}

4

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplInsectPlag]{疫病蟲群}

5

【恢復充能】此法杖每日黎明時恢復1d6 + 4已消耗的充能。若你消耗了最後1點充能，擲[[/r 1d20]]。若結果為1，一群昆蟲會吞噬並摧毀法杖，隨後散去。
Staff of Swarming Insects.name: 蟲群法杖

Staff of the Python.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbafcStaffalsoa]{法杖}，非普通（需同調）

你可以採取魔法動作投擲這根法杖，使其落在位於你10呎內的一處未佔據空間，並令法杖在該空間化為一條巨型蟒蛇。這條蛇受你控制，與你共用先攻值，並緊接在你的回合結束後進行其回合。

在你的回合中，若蛇位於你60呎內且你未陷入失能狀態，你可以在心中命令這條蛇（無需動作）。你決定蛇在其回合中採取什麼動作及移動到何處，或者你可以對其下達一般性的命令，例如攻擊你的敵人或守衛某個地點。若你未下達命令，蛇會自我防衛。

你可以採取附贈動作，命令蛇在其目前所在的空間恢復為法杖形態，之後1小時內你無法再次使用法杖的此屬性。若蛇的生命值降至0，蛇會死亡並恢復為法杖形態，接著法杖碎裂並被摧毀。若蛇在失去所有生命值前恢復為法杖形態，蛇會恢復所有生命值。
Staff of the Python.name: 巨蟒法杖

Ioun Stone of Intellect.name: 艾恩石，才智
Ioun Stone of Intellect.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgIounStone0000]{Ioun Stone}

When you take a Magic action to toss an Ioun Stone into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three Ioun Stones orbiting your head at the same time.

As a Utilize action, you can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head. If your Attunement to an Ioun Stone ends while it’s orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

Your Intelligence increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this marbled scarlet and blue sphere orbits your head.

Enhanced Intellect: Intelligence Bonus.description: Your Intelligence increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this marbled scarlet and blue sphere orbits your head.
Enhanced Intellect: Intelligence Bonus.name: Enhanced Intellect: Intelligence Bonus

Potion of Healing (Greater).name: 高等治療藥水
Potion of Healing (Greater).description:
藥水，非普通

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你恢復4d4 + 4生命值。

無論藥效如何，這瓶藥水的紅色液體在搖晃時都會閃爍。

Tentacle Rod.name: 觸手權杖
Tentacle Rod.description:
權杖，珍稀（需同調）

這根權杖的末端長著三條富有彈性的觸手。持握這根權杖期間，你可以採取魔法動作指揮觸手向外伸展，每條觸手各攻擊位於你15呎內一名你所能看見的生物。為每條觸手各進行一次加值為+9的近戰攻擊檢定。觸手命中時造成1d6心靈傷害。若你以三條觸手都命中同一個目標，該目標必須成功通過一次DC 15的敏捷豁免，否則陷入&Reference[Restrained apply=false]{束縛}狀態，直到你陷入&Reference[Incapacitated apply=false]{失能}狀態、或採取附贈動作釋放目標，抑或目標不再位於你15呎內。以此方式陷入束縛狀態期間，目標在其每個回合開始時承受3d6心靈傷害。在其每個回合結束時，目標重複此豁免，成功時結束其身上的效應。

Cannon.name: Cannon
Cannon.description:
Large Object

Armor Class: 19 Hit Points: 75

Cannonball (Requires Load and Aim). Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 600/2,400 ft. Hit: 44 (8d10) Bludgeoning damage.

A Cannon uses gunpowder or arcane power to propel heavy iron balls at destructive speeds. A Cannon is usually attached to a wooden frame with wheels. Loading a Cannon requires the Utilize action, and aiming it requires another Utilize action. Then a crew member can take the Cannonball action.

Amulet of Health.name: 強健護符
Amulet of Health.description:
奇物，珍稀（需同調）

佩戴這枚護符期間，你的體質為19。若你未佩戴護符時的體質已達19或更高，護符對你沒有效果。

Throw Bands.name: 投擲鐵索
Throw Bands.target: 你所能看見的巨型或更小體型的生物

Iron Bands of Bilarro.name: 比拉羅的鐵索
Iron Bands of Bilarro.description:
奇物，珍稀

這顆鏽跡斑斑的鐵球直徑3吋，重1磅。你可以採取魔法動作將鐵球扔向位於你60呎內一名你所能看見的巨型或更小體型的生物。鐵球會在空中飛行時展開成為一團鐵索。

進行一次遠程攻擊檢定，將你的熟練加值和敏捷調整值加到這次攻擊檢定中。若攻擊命中，目標會陷入&Reference[Restrained apply=false]{束縛}狀態，直到你採取附贈動作下令釋放該目標。若攻擊未命中，或是你下達了釋放命令，鐵索會重新收縮為鐵球。

一個能觸及到鐵索的生物（包括被鐵索束縛的生物）可以採取動作進行一次DC 20的力量（運動）檢定來嘗試打破鐵索。若檢定成功，該物品將被摧毀，被束縛的生物將被釋放。若檢定失敗，進行此次檢定的生物在隨後的24小時內進行的任何進一步嘗試都會自動失敗。

鐵索一經使用，直到下個黎明前都無法再次使用。

Horseshoes of a Zephyr.description:
奇物，非常珍稀

These horseshoes come in a set of four. As a Magic action, you can touch one of the horseshoes to the hoof of a horse or similar creature, whereupon the horseshoe affixes itself to the hoof. Removing a horseshoe also takes a Magic action.

While all four shoes are affixed to the hooves of a horse or similar creature, they allow the creature to move normally while floating 4 inches above a surface. This effect means the creature can cross or stand above nonsolid or unstable surfaces, such as water or lava. The creature leaves no tracks and ignores &Reference[Difficult Terrain]. In addition, the creature can travel for up to 12 hours a day without gaining &Reference[Exhaustion] levels from extended travel.
Horseshoes of a Zephyr.name: 西風馬蹄鐵

Assassin's Blood.description:
Ingested Poison

A creature subjected to Assassin's Blood makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 6 (1d12) Poison damage and has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition for 24 hours. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.
Assassin's Blood.name: Assassin's Blood

Card Effect.chatFlavor: Card's effect occurs immediately upon draw
Card Effect.name: Card Effect
Card Effect.duration: until the avatar drops to 0 Hit Points or you die

Skull.name: Skull
Skull.description: An @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.dmgAvatarofDeath]{Avatar of Death} appears in an unoccupied space as close to you as possible. The avatar targets only you with its attacks, appearing as a ghostly skeleton clad in a tattered black robe and carrying a spectral scythe. The avatar disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or you die. If an ally of yours deals damage to the avatar, that ally summons another Avatar of Death . The new avatar appears in an unoccupied space as close to that ally as possible and targets only that ally with its attacks. You and your allies can each summon only one avatar as a consequence of this draw. A creature slain by an avatar can’t be restored to life.

Hag Eye.name: 鬼婆之眼
Hag Eye.description:
奇物，非普通

一顆鬼婆之眼具有3點充能。你佩戴或持握這件物品期間，可以消耗1點充能以施放法術@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDarkvision]{黑暗視覺}（只能以自身為目標）或@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSeeInvisib]{識破隱形}。鬼婆之眼在每日黎明時恢復全部已消耗的充能。

【集會感測器】鬼婆之眼通常會被託付給鬼婆的僕從，以進行保護與轉移。隸屬於創造該鬼婆之眼集會的鬼婆，若與鬼婆之眼處於同一存在位面上，則可以採取魔法動作透過鬼婆之眼視物。只要該鬼婆維持專注，則該效應將會一直持續。同一集會中的多個鬼婆可以同時透過該鬼婆之眼視物。

【創造鬼婆之眼】只有鬼婆集會才能夠製造此物品，其成品由裹在清漆中的真實眼球製成，並通常鑲在吊墜或其他可佩戴的物品之上。一個鬼婆集會在同一時間只能擁有一顆鬼婆之眼，製作新的則需全部三位集會成員進行一場特殊儀式。這場儀式耗時1小時，且若一名或多名鬼婆陷入&Reference[Incapacitated apply=false]{失能}狀態，則儀式無法進行。若鬼婆們在儀式期間採取任何其他動作，則儀式失敗並終止。

Sword of Sharpness.description:
Weapon (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepGlaive0000]{Glaive}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepGreatsword]{Greatsword}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepLongsword0]{Longsword}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepScimitar00]{Scimitar})，非常珍稀（需同調）

When you attack an object with this magic weapon and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice against the target.

When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the d20 for the attack roll, that target takes an extra 14 Slashing damage and gains 1 &Reference[Exhaustion] level.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgFoundryRefere.JournalEntryPage.Ok4iCgD25ENgoRxE cite=false caption=false classes="hide-in-embed"]
Sword of Sharpness.name: Sword of Sharpness

Observatory Charm.description: After spending a Long Rest in your Observatory, you gain a magical Charm (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.U9qU1oUFTPAK7g50]{Supernatural Gifts}) that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The Charm allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplContactOth]{Contact Other Plane} without expending a spell slot. You can’t gain this Charm again while you still have it.
Observatory Charm.name: Observatory Charm

Attack vs Giant.chatFlavor: 命中時：[[/save ability=str dc=15]]，失敗時陷入&Reference[prone]{伏地}狀態
Attack vs Giant.name: 攻擊巨人

Giant Slayer.name: 巨人殺手
Giant Slayer.description:
武器（任意簡易或軍用），珍稀

你以這把魔法武器所進行的攻擊檢定與傷害擲骰獲得+1加值。

當你以這把武器命中一名巨人時，該巨人額外承受2d6傷害，傷害類型與武器的傷害類型相同，且必須成功通過一次DC 15的力量豁免，否則陷入伏地狀態。

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgFoundryRefere.JournalEntryPage.Ok4iCgD25ENgoRxE cite=false caption=false classes="hide-in-embed"]

Ring of Shooting Stars.name: 流星戒指
Ring of Shooting Stars.description:
Ring，非常珍稀（需同調）

You can cast Dancing Lights or Light from the ring.

The ring has 6 charges and regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn. You can expend its charges to use the properties below.

Faerie Fire. You can expend 1 charge to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFaerieFire]{Faerie Fire} from the ring.

Lightning Spheres. You can expend 2 charges as a Magic action to create up to four 3-foot-diameter spheres of lightning.

Each sphere appears in an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet of yourself. The spheres last as long as you maintain Concentration, up to 1 minute. Each sphere sheds Dim Light in a 30-foot radius.

As a Bonus Action, you can move each sphere up to 30 feet, but no farther than 120 feet away from yourself. The first time the sphere comes within 5 feet of a creature other than you that isn’t behind &Reference[Total Cover apply=false], the sphere discharges lightning at that creature and disappears. That creature makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes Lightning damage based on the number of spheres you created, as shown in the following table. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

Number of Spheres

Lightning Damage
1[[/damage 4d12 lightning]]
3[[/damage 2d6 lightning]]
2[[/damage 5d4 lightning]]
4[[/damage 2d4 lightning]]

Shooting Stars. You can expend 1 to 3 charges as a Magic action. For every charge you expend, you launch a glowing mote of light from the ring at a point you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Each creature in a 15-foot Cube originating from that point is showered in sparks and makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d4 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Foundry Note

The Create Lightning Spheres and Shooting Stars activities allow you to select the the number of spheres/motes you would like to create and places a measured template for each one.

Fruit of Restoration.name: Fruit of Restoration
Fruit of Restoration.description: One plant in your Greenhouse has three magical fruits growing on it. Any creature that eats one of these fruits gains the benefit of a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplLesserRest]{Lesser Restoration} spell. Fruits that aren’t eaten within 24 hours of being picked lose their magic. The plant replaces all picked fruits daily at dawn, and it can’t be transplanted without killing it.

Swear Oath.name: Swear Oath
Swear Oath.condition: when you make a ranged attack with this weapon

Sworn Enemy.name: Sworn Enemy
Sworn Enemy.description:
When you make a ranged attack roll with this weapon against your sworn enemy, you have Advantage on the roll. In addition, your target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover, and you suffer no Disadvantage due to long range. If the attack hits, your sworn enemy takes an extra 3d6 Piercing damage.

While your sworn enemy lives, you have Disadvantage on attack rolls with all other weapons.

Oathbow.description:
Weapon (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepLongbow000]{Longbow} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepShortbow00]{Shortbow})，非常珍稀（需同調）

When you nock an arrow on this bow, it whispers in Elvish, “Swift defeat to my enemies.” When you use this weapon to make a ranged attack, you can utter or sign the following command words: “Swift death to you who have wronged me.” The target of your attack becomes your sworn enemy until it dies or until dawn 7 days later. You can have only one such sworn enemy at a time. When your sworn enemy dies, you can choose a new one after the next dawn.

When you make a ranged attack roll with this weapon against your sworn enemy, you have Advantage on the roll. In addition, your target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover, and you suffer no Disadvantage due to long range. If the attack hits, your sworn enemy takes an extra 3d6 Piercing damage.

While your sworn enemy lives, you have Disadvantage on attack rolls with all other weapons.

Oathbow.name: 誓仇弓

Riding Broom (High Weight).description: 掃帚最多可載重400磅，但載重超過200磅時，其飛行速度會降低到30呎。
Riding Broom (High Weight).name: 騎乘掃帚（重載）

Riding Broom (Low Weight).name: 騎乘掃帚（輕載）
Riding Broom (Low Weight).description: 掃帚最多可載重400磅，但載重超過200磅時，其飛行速度會降低到30呎。

Send Alone or Recall.name: 獨自派遣或召回
Send Alone or Recall.range: 你所指名且熟悉的目的地

Broom of Flying.description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

這把掃帚在平時如同一把普通的掃帚，你可以騎在其上並採取魔法動作，使其懸浮在你身下，此時其可以載著你在空中飛行。其飛行速度為50呎，最多可載重400磅，但載重超過200磅時，其飛行速度會降低到30呎。掃帚在你著陸或不再騎乘時便會停止懸浮。

以魔法動作，你可以指名1哩內一個你熟悉的地點，並令掃帚自行飛往該處。而若掃帚在你周圍1哩以內，你也能夠採取魔法動作並說出命令詞，讓其自行回到你的身邊。
Broom of Flying.name: 飛天掃帚

Quiver of Ehlonna.name: 艾羅娜的箭袋
Quiver of Ehlonna.description:
奇物，非普通

這個箭袋有三個大小不一的隔層，每個隔層都連接著一個異次元空間。無論其中存放著多少東西，箭袋的總重量都永遠不會超過2磅。最小的隔層可以容納至多60支箭矢、弩矢或類似的物體；中等大小的隔層可以容納至多18支標槍或類似的物體；最大的隔層可以容納至多6件長條形的物體，例如弓、長棍、矛等。

你可以如同從普通的箭袋或劍鞘中抽出物品一般，抽出箭袋中所裝的任何物品。

Moon-Touched Sword.name: 觸月劍
Moon-Touched Sword.description:
武器（@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepGlaive0000]{長柄刀}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepGreatsword]{巨劍}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepLongsword0]{長劍}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepRapier0000]{刺劍}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepScimitar00]{彎刀}或@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepShortsword]{短劍}），普通

在黑暗中，這把武器出鞘的劍刃會散發月光，創造半徑15呎的明亮光照，並再向外延伸15呎的微光光照。

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgFoundryRefere.JournalEntryPage.Ok4iCgD25ENgoRxE cite=false caption=false classes="hide-in-embed"]

Staff of the Adder.name: 蝰蛇法杖
Staff of the Adder.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbafcStaffalsoa]{法杖}，非普通（需同調）

你可以採取附贈動作，使這根法杖的杖頭化為一顆活生生的毒蛇頭，持續1分鐘；或使法杖恢復為無生命的形態。

當你採取攻擊動作時，你可以用活化的蛇頭進行其中一次攻擊檢定，蛇頭的觸及為5呎。該次攻擊檢定使用你的熟練加值與感知調整值。命中時，目標承受1d6穿刺傷害與3d6毒素傷害。

蛇頭在活化期間可以被攻擊。蛇頭的AC為15、HP為20，並對毒素與心靈傷害具有免疫。若蛇頭的生命值降至0，法杖便被摧毀。只要法杖未被摧毀，其在恢復為無生命形態時就會恢復所有失去的生命值。

Foundry 註記

此物品包含20次有限使用次數，可用來追蹤蛇頭的HP。喚醒蛇頭行動會恢復全部20次使用次數，因此每次啟動蛇頭時，蛇頭都會處於滿HP。

Revert or Recall Goat of Traveling.chatFlavor: Each hour or portion thereof it spends in goat form costs 1 charge.
Revert or Recall Goat of Traveling.name: Revert or Recall Goat of Traveling

Ivory Goats.name: Ivory Goats
Ivory Goats.description:
See @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFigurineOfWon]{Figurine of Wondrous Power}

These ivory statuettes of goats are always created in sets of three. Each goat looks unique and functions differently from the others. Their properties are as follows:

Goat of Terror. This figurine can become a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobGiantGoat0]{Giant Goat} for up to 3 hours. The goat can’t attack, but you can (harmlessly) remove its horns and use them as weapons. One horn becomes a +1 Lance , and the other becomes a +2 Longsword. Removing a horn requires a Magic action, and the weapons disappear and the horns return when the goat reverts to figurine form. While you ride the goat, any Hostile creature that starts its turn within a 30-foot Emanation originating from the goat must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute, until you are no longer riding the goat, or until the goat reverts to figurine form. The Frightened creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once it succeeds on the save, a creature is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours. Once the figurine has been used, it can’t be used again until 15 days have passed.

Goat of Traveling. This figurine can become a Large goat with the same statistics as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobRidingHors]{Riding Horse}. It has 24 charges, and each hour or portion thereof it spends in goat form costs 1 charge. While it has charges, you can use it as often as you wish. When it runs out of charges, it reverts to a figurine and can’t be used again until 7 days have passed, when it regains all expended charges.

Foundry Note

The Revert or Recall Goat of Traveling activity is optionally provided to aid in tracking the non-contiguous 24 hours the figurine can remain in goat form. When reverting to a figurine, the scaling value for consumption represents the number of hours spent in goat form. When recalling the figurine to goat form, uncheck the "Consume Item Use?" checkbox when using this activity.

Goat of Travail. This figurine can become a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobGiantGoat0]{Giant Goat} for up to 3 hours. Once it has been used, it can’t be used again until 30 days have passed.

Blessing of Magic Resistance.description: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Blessing of Magic Resistance.name: Blessing of Magic Resistance

Dynamite Stick.name: Dynamite Stick
Dynamite Stick.description:
An an action, you can light a Dynamite Stick and throw it at a point up to 60 feet away, where it explodes. Each creature in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

It takes 1 minute to bind two or more Dynamite Sticks together so they explode at the same time. Each stick after the first increases the damage by 1d6 (to a maximum of 10d6) and the effect’s radius by 5 feet (to a maximum of 20 feet).

It takes 1 minute to rig dynamite with a longer fuse so it explodes after a longer period of time, such as 1 minute or 10 minutes.

Foundry Note

The Throw Bundle activity allows you to select the number of bundled sticks and automatically adjusts the measured template and damage values.

To support bundling rather than increasing the quantity of Dynamite Sticks you have in your inventory, increase the max Limited Uses value of this item.

Potion of Fire Breath.description:
藥水，非普通

飲用這瓶藥水後，你可以採取附贈動作，向位於你30呎內的一個目標吐出火焰。目標進行一次DC 13的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗時受到4d6火焰傷害，豁免成功時則傷害減半。此效應在你吐出三次火焰或經過1小時後結束。

這瓶藥水中的橙色液體閃爍不定，每當開啟時，容器頂部就會充滿煙霧並飄散出來。
Potion of Fire Breath.name: 火焰吐息藥水

Bead of Refreshment.name: 鮮水珠
Bead of Refreshment.description:
奇物，普通

這顆無味的凝膠珠會在液體中溶解，將至多1品脫的液體轉化為清涼的新鮮飲用水。此珠對魔法液體或毒藥等有害物質無效。

Talking Doll.name: 說話玩偶
Talking Doll.description:
奇物，普通（需同調）

當這個玩偶位於你5呎內時，你可以花費一次短休，教導其說出至多六句短語，每句短語的長度都不得超過六個字，並為每句短語設定玩偶開口的條件。你也可以用新的短語取代舊的。無論條件為何，都必須發生在玩偶5呎內，才能使其開口說話。例如，每當有人拿起這個玩偶時，其可能會說：「我想要一塊糖果。」當你與玩偶的同調結束時，玩偶的短語會全部消失。

Mac-Fuirmidh Cittern Instrument of the B.name: Mac-Fuirmidh Cittern Instrument of the Bards
Mac-Fuirmidh Cittern Instrument of the B.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgInstrumentOfT]{Instrument of the Bards}

An Instrument of the Bards is superior to an ordinary instrument in every way.

A creature that attempts to play the instrument without being attuned to it must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=15 format=long]] or take [[/damage 2d4 type=psychic]] damage.

You can play the instrument to cast one of its spells. Once the instrument has been used to cast a spell, it can’t be used to cast that spell again until the next dawn. The spells use your spellcasting ability and spell save DC.

Staff of Healing.name: 治癒法杖
Staff of Healing.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbafcStaffalsoa]{法杖}，珍稀（需由吟遊詩人、牧師或德魯伊同調）

這根法杖具有10點充能。持握法杖期間，你可以透過法杖施放下表中的一道法術，使用你的施法屬性調整值。下表列出施放各法術所需消耗的充能。

法術

充能消耗

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplCureWounds]{治療傷勢}

每環1點充能（4環法術最多4點）

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplLesserRest]{次級復原術}

2

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplMassCureWo]{群體治療傷勢}

5

【恢復充能】此法杖每日黎明時恢復1d6 + 4已消耗的充能。若你消耗了最後1點充能，擲[[/r 1d20]]。若結果為1，法杖會在一道閃光中消失，永遠失落。

Oil of Slipperiness.name: 滑溜之油
Oil of Slipperiness.description:
藥水，非普通

一小瓶這種油可以覆蓋一名中型或更小的生物，連同其穿戴與攜帶的裝備（每高於中型一個體型等級，就需要多一小瓶）。塗抹油需要10分鐘。被影響的生物接著獲得@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFreedomofM]{行動自如術}法術的效應，持續8小時。

此外，你可以採取魔法動作將油倒在地面上，覆蓋10呎見方區域，並在該區域內重現@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGrease0000]{油膩術}法術的效應，持續8小時。

這種黏稠的黑色油膏濃稠而沉重，但倒出時會迅速流動。

Ruby of the War Mage.description:
奇物，普通（需由施法者同調）

這顆直徑1吋的紅寶石刻有異界符文，讓你能將一把簡易或軍用武器當作你法術的施法法器。要使此屬性生效，你必須將紅寶石壓在武器上至少10分鐘，使其附著。此後，除非你以魔法動作將其卸下、該武器被摧毀，或你與該紅寶石的同調結束，否則紅寶石無法被移除。

Foundry 註記

名為附著紅石的行動可讓你選擇單一一把簡易或軍用武器，將其標記為法器，並在其名稱前加上「戰法師」以便追蹤。你可以再次使用戰法師紅石，以查看被附魔的物品，並可選擇將其移除。
Ruby of the War Mage.name: 戰法師紅石

Suspended Cauldron.name: Suspended Cauldron
Suspended Cauldron.description:
Large Object

Armor Class: 19 Hit Points: 20

Spill (Requires a Full Cauldron). Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 10-foot square directly below the cauldron. Failure: 10 (3d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

An iron pot is suspended so that it can be tipped easily, spilling its contents. Once emptied, a cauldron must be refilled before it can be used again. Filling the cauldron requires three Utilize actions. Then a crew member can take the Spill action.

Cauldrons are typically filled with boiling oil but can be filled with other substances, such as acid or green slime (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.lVkdQivhFHqVmxg7]{Hazards} in this chapter), with different effects.

Foundry Note

This item has 3 limited uses for tracking filling.

The Fill activity grants one use so after three uses you can use the Spill activity.

Charm of Feather Falling.name: Charm of Feather Falling
Charm of Feather Falling.description:
超自然贈禮（護咒）

This Charm grants you the benefits of a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgRingOfFeather]{Ring of Feather Falling}. These benefits last for 10 days, after which the Charm vanishes from you.

Foundry Note

The duration must be tracked manually.

Bracers of Defense.name: 防禦護腕
Bracers of Defense.description:
奇物，珍稀（需同調）

穿戴這對護腕期間，若你未穿著護甲且未使用盾牌，你的護甲等級獲得+2加值。

Cubic Gate.name: 界門魔方
Cubic Gate.description:
奇物, Legendary

This cube is 3 inches across and radiates palpable magical energy. The six sides of the cube are each keyed to a different plane of existence, one of which is the Material Plane. The other sides are linked to planes determined by the DM.

The cube has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. As a Magic action, you can expend 1 of the cube’s charges to cast one of the following spells using the cube.

Gate. Pressing one side of the cube, you cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGate000000]{Gate}, opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side.

Plane Shift. Pressing one side of the cube twice, you cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplPlaneShift]{Plane Shift}, transporting the targets to the plane of existence keyed to that side.

Dark Shard Amulet.name: 黑暗碎片護符
Dark Shard Amulet.description:
奇物，普通（需由契術師同調）

這枚護符由一塊源自異界、極具韌性的材料碎片製成。你佩戴此護符期間，你獲得下列好處。

【施法法器】你可以將此護符作為你的契術師法術的施法法器。

【未知法術】你可以採取魔法動作，嘗試施放一道你尚未習得的戲法。該戲法必須位於契術師法術列表中，且施法時間為一個動作，並且你要進行一次DC 10的智力（奧秘）檢定。檢定成功時，你施放該法術；檢定失敗時，該法術施放失敗，且用於施法的動作被浪費。無論成功與否，直到你完成一次長休前，你都無法再次使用此屬性。

Foundry 註記

名為施放所選戲法的行動僅供選用，啟用前必須編輯並設定為所選的契術師戲法。

Ebony Fly.name: Ebony Fly
Ebony Fly.description:
See @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFigurineOfWon]{Figurine of Wondrous Power}

This ebony statuette, carved in the likeness of a horsefly, can become a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.dmgGiantFly00000]{Giant Fly} for up to 12 hours and can be ridden as a mount. Once it has been used, it can’t be used again until 2 days have passed.

Foundry Note

This item's limited uses represent the 2 days required before the figurine can be used again.

Potion of Flying.name: 飛行藥水
Potion of Flying.description:
藥水，極珍稀

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你獲得等同於你移動速度的飛行速度，並且可以懸浮，持續1小時。藥水效果消退時，若你身在空中，除非你有其他方式保持在空中，否則會墜落。

這瓶藥水的透明液體漂浮在容器頂部，其中飄蕩著混濁的白色雜質。

Foundry 註記

名為飛行者的主動效果可用於追蹤，但無法自動化速度的調整。

Potion of Gaseous Form.name: 氣化形體藥水
Potion of Gaseous Form.description:
藥水，珍稀

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你獲得@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGaseousFor]{氣化形體}法術的效應，持續1小時（無需專注），或直到你採取附贈動作結束該效應為止。

這瓶藥水的容器看起來裝著如水般流動與傾瀉的霧氣。

Gauntlets of Ogre Power.description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

穿戴這雙護手期間，你的力量為19。若你未穿戴護手時的力量已達19或更高，護手對你沒有效果。
Gauntlets of Ogre Power.name: 食人魔力量護手

Universal Solvent.description:
奇物, Legendary

This tube holds milky liquid with a strong alcohol smell. When found, a tube contains 1d6 + 1 ounces.

You can take a Utilize action to pour 1 or more ounces of solvent from the tube onto a surface within reach. Each ounce instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches, including @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgSovereignGlue]{Sovereign Glue}.

Foundry Note

This item includes 7 limited uses. The Determine Ounces activity can be used to determine the number of ounces equivalent to 1d6 + 1.

The Apply Solvent activity allows you to select the number of ounces you're applying.
Universal Solvent.name: 萬溶劑

Holy Avenger.name: Holy Avenger
Holy Avenger.description:
武器（任意簡易或軍用）, Legendary (Requires Attunement by a Paladin)

You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a Fiend or an Undead with it, that creature takes an extra 2d10 Radiant damage.

While you hold the drawn weapon, it creates a 10-foot Emanation originating from you. You and all creatures Friendly to you in the Emanation have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. If you have 17 or more levels in the Paladin class, the size of the Emanation increases to 30 feet.

[[10 + floor(@classes.paladin.levels / 17) * 20]]{Emanation Size (feet)}

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgFoundryRefere.JournalEntryPage.Ok4iCgD25ENgoRxE cite=false caption=false classes="hide-in-embed"]

Marble Elephant.name: Marble Elephant
Marble Elephant.description:
See @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFigurineOfWon]{Figurine of Wondrous Power}

This marble statuette resembles a trumpeting elephant. It can become an @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobElephant00]{Elephant} for up to 24 hours. Once it has been used, it can’t be used again until 7 days have passed.

Foundry Note

This item's limited uses represent the 7 days required before the figurine can be used again.

Moon.name: Moon
Moon.description: You gain the ability to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} 1d3 times.

Robe of Stars.name: 星辰法袍
Robe of Stars.description:
奇物，非常珍稀（需同調）

This black or dark-blue robe is embroidered with small white or silver stars. You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws while you wear it.

Six stars, located on the robe’s upper-front portion, are particularly large. While wearing this robe, you can take a Magic action to remove one of the stars and expend it to cast the level 5 version of @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{Magic Missile}. Daily at dusk, 1d6 removed stars reappear on the robe.

While you wear the robe, you can take a Magic action to enter the Astral Plane along with everything you are wearing and carrying. You remain there until you take a Magic action to return to the plane you were on. You reappear in the last space you occupied or, if that space is occupied, the nearest unoccupied space.

Foundry Note

The Enter/Exit Astral Plane activity includes a 5 foot measured template that can be used to mark where you exited the Astral Plane for tracking.

Siege Tower.name: Siege Tower
Siege Tower.description:
Gargantuan Object

Armor Class: 15 Hit Points: 200

A Siege Tower is a mobile wooden structure with a beam frame and slats in its walls. Large wooden wheels or rollers allow the tower to be pushed or pulled by soldiers or beasts of burden. Medium or smaller creatures can use the Siege Tower to reach the top of walls up to 40 feet high. A creature in the tower has &Reference[Total Cover] against attacks and other effects that originate outside it.

Wand of Secrets.name: 探秘魔杖
Wand of Secrets.description:
魔杖，非普通

這根魔杖具有3點充能，並在每日黎明時恢復1d3已消耗的充能。持握魔杖期間，你可以採取魔法動作消耗1點充能；若有密門或陷阱位於你60呎內，魔杖會發出脈動並指向離你最近的一處。

Yellow Mold.name: Yellow Mold
Yellow Mold.description:
Deadly Hazard (Levels 1–4) or Nuisance Hazard (Levels 5–10)

Actor: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.dmgYellowMold000]{Yellow Mold}

Yellow mold grows in dark places, and one patch covers a 5-foot square. If touched, the mold ejects a cloud of spores that fills a 10-foot Cube. Any creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) Poison damage and have the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition for 1 minute. While Poisoned in this way, the creature takes 5 (1d10) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Direct sunlight or any amount of Fire damage destroys a patch of yellow mold.

Brown Mold.description:
Deadly Hazard (Levels 5–10) or Nuisance Hazard (Levels 11–16)

Actor: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.dmgBrownMold0000]{Brown Mold}

Brown mold resembles a furry, light-brown carpet. This fungus feeds on warmth, drawing heat from anything around itself. One patch of brown mold covers a 10-foot square, and the temperature within 30 feet of it is always frigid.

When a creature enters a space within 5 feet of the mold for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, the creature makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Brown mold has Immunity to Fire damage, and any source of fire brought within 5 feet of it causes the mold to instantly expand across a surface and toward the fire, creating a new patch that covers a 10-foot square. A patch of brown mold exposed to an effect that deals any amount of Cold damage is destroyed instantly.
Brown Mold.name: Brown Mold

Potion of Speed.description:
藥水，極珍稀

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你獲得@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplHaste00000]{加速術}法術的效應，持續1分鐘（無需專注），且不會承受效應結束時通常會出現的倦意。

這瓶藥水的黃色液體帶有黑色紋路，並自行旋轉。
Potion of Speed.name: 速度藥水

Heward's Handy Spice Pouch.description:
奇物，普通

這個腰間囊袋看起來是空的，具有10次充能。持握此囊袋期間，你可以採取魔法動作，消耗1充能，說出任何一種非魔法的食物調味料（例如鹽、胡椒、番紅花或香菜），並從囊袋中取出一撮所需的調味料。一撮足以為一餐調味。此囊袋每日黎明時恢復1d6 + 4已消耗的充能。
Heward's Handy Spice Pouch.name: 霍華德的便利香料包

Ring of Evasion.description:
Ring，珍稀（需同調）

This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. When you fail a Dexterity saving throw while wearing the ring, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 charge to succeed on that save instead.
Ring of Evasion.name: 閃避戒指

Webs.name: Webs
Webs.description:
Nuisance Hazard (Levels 1–4)

Actor: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.dmgWebs000000000]{Webs}

Giant spiders weave thick, sticky webs across passages and at the bottom of pits to snare prey. These web-filled areas are &Reference[Difficult Terrain].

A creature that enters a web-filled area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or have the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition. As an action, a creature Restrained by the webs can try to escape from them, doing so with a successful DC 12 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.

Each 10-foot Cube of webs has AC 10; HP 15; Vulnerability to Fire damage; and Immunity to Piercing, Poison, and Psychic damage.

Animate.name: 活化
Animate.duration: 若掃帚在變回非活化形態前生命值降至0。

Render Broom Inanimate.chatFlavor: 使掃帚恢復為非活化狀態
Render Broom Inanimate.name: 恢復非活化

Baba Yaga's Dancing Broom.name: 芭芭·雅嘎的舞空帚
Baba Yaga's Dancing Broom.description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

至高妖精芭芭·雅嘎精心製作了許多此類魔法掃帚，每把看起來都不盡相同。當你持握該掃帚時，你可以採取魔法動作，將其變形為一把受你控制的@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.dmgnpcAnimatedBr]{活化掃帚}。然後，該掃帚將移動至距離你最近的一處未佔據空間。該掃帚緊接在你的先攻順位後行動，並保持活化，直到你採取附贈動作說出命令詞，使其變回非活化狀態。

在你的回合中，只要你未陷入失能狀態，且掃帚位於你30呎範圍內，你便可以在心中指揮該掃帚（無需動作）。你決定掃帚在其回合中的移動和動作，或者你也可以給出籠統的指令，例如攻擊你的敵人或守衛某個地點。

若掃帚的生命值降至0，則其將粉碎並被摧毀。若掃帚在生命值未降至0時恢復非活化狀態，則其將恢復失去的所有生命值。

Quaal's Feather Token (Bird).name: Quaal's Feather Token (Bird)
Quaal's Feather Token (Bird).description:
奇物，珍稀, See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgQuaalsFeather]{Quaal's Feather Token}

You can take a Magic action to toss the token 5 feet into the air. The token disappears and an enormous, multicolored bird takes its place. The bird has the statistics of a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.p980augbCIdpK9ZX]{Roc}, but it can’t attack. It obeys your simple commands and can carry up to 500 pounds while flying at its maximum speed (16 miles per hour for a maximum of 144 miles per day, with a 1-hour rest for every 3 hours of flying) or 1,000 pounds at half that speed. The bird disappears after flying its maximum distance for a day or if it drops to 0 Hit Points. You can dismiss the bird as a Magic action.

Use.name: Use
Use.duration: The bird disappears after flying its maximum distance for a day or if it drops to 0 Hit Points. You can dismiss the bird as a Magic action.

Charm of Vitality.description:
超自然贈禮（護咒）

This Charm allows you to give yourself the benefit of a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfVital]{Potion of Vitality} as a Magic action. Once you do so, the Charm vanishes from you.
Charm of Vitality.name: Charm of Vitality

Pearl of Power.description:
奇物，非普通（需由施法者同調）

在你隨身攜帶這顆珍珠期間，你可以採取魔法動作來恢復一枚已消耗的三環或更低環階的法術位。這顆珍珠一經使用，直到下個黎明前都無法再次使用。
Pearl of Power.name: 法力再生珍珠

Gemstone (100 GP).name: Gemstone (100 GP)
Gemstone (100 GP).description: Gemstones are small, lightweight, and easily secured compared to their same value in coins.

Flamethrower Coach.description:
Large Object

Armor Class: 19 Hit Points: 100

Flamethrower. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Failure: 14 (4d6) Fire damage, and the creature starts burning. Success: Half damage only.

Powered by magic, this iron coach has a flamethrower turret mounted atop it.

The coach can accommodate up to two Medium creatures. An iron hatch in the vehicle’s underbelly grants access. Narrow slits in the front, sides, and back of the coach allow its occupants to see outside. A creature in the coach has Three-Quarters Cover against attacks and other effects that originate outside it.

The coach is designed for a crew of two: a driver and a gunner. The driver can take the Utilize action to move and turn the coach, which has a Speed of 30 feet, using levers and pedals inside. The gunner can use the Flamethrower action to aim and fire it.
Flamethrower Coach.name: Flamethrower Coach

Gemstone (10 GP).description: Gemstones are small, lightweight, and easily secured compared to their same value in coins.
Gemstone (10 GP).name: Gemstone (10 GP)

Frost Brand.description:
Weapon (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepGlaive0000]{Glaive}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepGreatsword]{Greatsword}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepLongsword0]{Longsword}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepRapier0000]{Rapier}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepScimitar00]{Scimitar}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepShortsword]{Shortsword})，非常珍稀（需同調）

When you hit with an attack roll using this magic weapon, the target takes an extra 1d6 Cold damage. In addition, while you hold the weapon, you have Resistance to Fire damage.

In freezing temperatures, the weapon sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

When you draw this weapon, you can extinguish all nonmagical flames within 30 feet of yourself. Once used, this property can’t be used again for 1 hour.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgFoundryRefere.JournalEntryPage.Ok4iCgD25ENgoRxE cite=false caption=false classes="hide-in-embed"]
Frost Brand.name: Frost Brand

Arcane Study Charm.name: Arcane Study Charm
Arcane Study Charm.description: After spending a Long Rest in your Bastion, you gain a magical Charm (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.U9qU1oUFTPAK7g50]{Supernatural Gifts}) that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The Charm allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplIdentify00]{Identify} without expending a spell slot or using Material components. You can’t gain this Charm again while you still have it.

Count Beans.name: 清點豆子
Count Beans.chatFlavor: 在布袋中發現3d4顆乾燥的豆子。

Bag of Beans.name: 魔豆之袋
Bag of Beans.description:
奇物，珍稀

這個沉重的布袋被找到時裝著3d4顆乾燥的豆子。不論布袋中裝了多少顆豆子，布袋都重半磅，並在其內部不再包含豆子時變為@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagPouch000000]{非魔法物品}。

若你把一顆或更多豆子倒出，這些豆子會在以其自身為中心、半徑10呎的球形區域內爆炸，該球形區域內包括你在內的每個生物都要進行一次DC 15的敏捷豁免。豁免失敗時承受5d4力場傷害，豁免成功則傷害減半。所有被倒出的豆子都會在爆炸中被摧毀。

若你從布袋中取出1顆豆子，將其種入泥土或沙子中並澆上水，1分鐘後，豆子會消失，並從其被種下的地面產生一種效應。DM可以從下表中選擇一種效應，或隨機決定。

魔豆之袋效應（點擊展開）

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgBagOfBeansEff rollable caption=false]

Foundry 註記

取得這件物品後，可以使用清點豆子行動來決定其中所含乾燥豆子的數量，並據此設定這件物品的使用次數。

Boots of Levitation.name: 浮空之靴
Boots of Levitation.description:
奇物，珍稀（需同調）

穿戴這雙靴子期間，你可以對自己施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplLevitate00]{浮空術}。

Potion of Invulnerability.description:
藥水，珍稀

飲用這瓶藥水後的1分鐘內，你對所有傷害具有抗力。

這瓶藥水的黏稠液體看起來像熔化的鐵。
Potion of Invulnerability.name: 無敵藥水

Potion of Vitality.description:
藥水，極珍稀

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，藥水會移除你身上的任何&Reference[Exhaustion apply=false]{力竭}等級，並結束你的&Reference[Poisoned apply=false]{中毒}狀態。在接下來的24小時內，你每消耗一顆生命骰，都恢復該生命骰的最大生命值。

這瓶藥水的深紅色液體會規律地閃現暗淡的光芒，令人聯想到心跳。

Foundry 註記

名為充滿活力的主動效果可用於追蹤。
Potion of Vitality.name: 活力藥水

Eyes of Minute Seeing.name: 微視鏡片
Eyes of Minute Seeing.description:
奇物，非普通

這副水晶鏡片適合戴在眼前。佩戴鏡片期間，你在1呎範圍內的視力會大幅提升，使你在該範圍內具有黑暗視覺，且你在檢視該範圍內的事物時，進行的智力（調查）檢定具有優勢。

Trebuchet.description:
Large Object

Armor Class: 15 Hit Points: 150

Trebuchet Stone (Requires Load and Aim). Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 300/1,200 ft. (can’t hit targets within 60 feet of itself). Hit: 44 (8d10) Bludgeoning damage.

A Trebuchet is a catapult that throws its payload in a high arc so it can hit targets behind walls. Loading a Trebuchet requires two Utilize actions, and aiming it requires two more Utilize actions. Then a crew member can take the Trebuchet Stone action.

Foundry Note

This item has 2 limited uses for tracking loading. Aiming must be tracked manually.

The Load activity grants one use so after two uses you can use the Trebuchet Stone activity.
Trebuchet.name: Trebuchet

Scimitar of Speed.name: 急速彎刀
Scimitar of Speed.description:
Weapon (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepScimitar00]{Scimitar})，非常珍稀（需同調）

You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, you can make one attack with it as a Bonus Action on each of your turns.

Gloves On.name: 穿戴手套
Gloves On.description: 你具有等同於你速度的攀爬速度與游泳速度，且你為攀爬或游泳而進行的力量（運動）檢定獲得+5加值。

Gloves of Swimming and Climbing.description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

穿戴這雙手套期間，你具有等同於你速度的攀爬速度與游泳速度，且你為攀爬或游泳而進行的力量（運動）檢定獲得+5加值。

Foundry 註記

此物品的穿戴手套 Active Effect 會將你的攀爬速度與游泳速度提升1，以表示其等同於你的速度。為攀爬或游泳而進行的檢定所獲得的+5加值，應在適用時作為情境加值加入。
Gloves of Swimming and Climbing.name: 游泳攀爬手套

Mangonel.description:
Large Object

Armor Class: 15 Hit Points: 100

Mangonel Stone (Requires Load and Aim). Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 200/800 ft. (can’t hit targets within 60 feet of itself). Hit: 27 (5d10) Bludgeoning damage.

A Mangonel is a catapult that hurls heavy projectiles in a high arc, so it can hit targets behind walls. Loading a Mangonel requires two Utilize actions, and aiming it requires two more Utilize actions. Then a crew member can take the Mangonel Stone action.

Foundry Note

This item has 2 limited uses for tracking loading. Aiming must be tracked manually.

The Load activity grants one use so after two uses you can use the Mangonel Stone activity.
Mangonel.name: Mangonel

Potion of Greater Invisibility.name: 高等隱形藥水
Potion of Greater Invisibility.description:
藥水，極珍稀

這瓶藥水的容器看起來是空的，但摸起來像裝有液體。當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你進入&Reference[Invisible apply=false]{隱形}狀態，持續1小時。

Sanctum Charm.description: After spending a Long Rest in your Bastion, you gain a magical Charm (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.U9qU1oUFTPAK7g50]{Supernatural Gifts}) that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The Charm allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplHeal000000]{Heal} once without expending a spell slot. You can’t gain this Charm again while you still have it.
Sanctum Charm.name: Sanctum Charm

Intercept Attack.name: 攔截攻擊
Intercept Attack.condition: 一名攻擊者對位於你5呎內的一個目標進行遠程攻擊檢定
Intercept Attack.chatFlavor: 你成為該次遠程攻擊的目標。
Intercept Attack.target: 對目標進行的攻擊檢定

Arrow-Catching Shield.description:
護甲（盾牌），珍稀（需同調）

持握這面盾牌期間，你的AC在對抗遠程攻擊檢定時獲得+2加值。此加值額外加在盾牌通常提供的AC加值上。

每當一名攻擊者對位於你5呎內的一個目標進行遠程攻擊檢定時，你可以採取反應，代替該目標成為此次攻擊的目標。

【Foundry 註記】

本物品提供的遠程攻擊AC加值效果可選擇使用，並可在對穿戴者進行遠程攻擊檢定前啟用。
Arrow-Catching Shield.name: 捕箭盾

Ranged Attack AC Bonus.description: 持握這面盾牌期間，你的AC在對抗遠程攻擊檢定時獲得+2加值。此加值額外加在盾牌通常提供的AC加值上。
Ranged Attack AC Bonus.name: 遠程攻擊AC加值

Gemstone (500 GP).description: Gemstones are small, lightweight, and easily secured compared to their same value in coins.
Gemstone (500 GP).name: Gemstone (500 GP)

Vicious Weapon.description:
武器（任意簡易或軍用），珍稀

這把魔法武器命中任何生物時，額外造成2d6傷害。此額外傷害的類型與武器的一般傷害類型相同。

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgFoundryRefere.JournalEntryPage.Ok4iCgD25ENgoRxE cite=false caption=false classes="hide-in-embed"]
Vicious Weapon.name: 惡毒武器

Blessing of Valhalla.name: Blessing of Valhalla
Blessing of Valhalla.description:
This Blessing grants you the power to summon spirit warriors, as if you are blowing a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgSilverHornOfV]{silver Horn of Valhalla}. Once you use this Blessing, you can’t use it again until 7 days have passed.

Foundry Note

This item includes a limited use but the 7 day recovery period will have to be tracked manually.

Potion of Poison.name: 劇毒藥水
Potion of Poison.description:
藥水，非普通

這瓶混合物看起來、聞起來和嚐起來都像治療藥水或其他有益藥水，但實際上是被幻術魔法偽裝的毒藥。鑑定術可以揭露其真實本質。

若你飲用這瓶藥水，你會受到4d6毒素傷害，並且必須成功通過一次DC 13的體質豁免，否則陷入中毒狀態，持續1小時。

Belt of Giant Strength (fire).name: Belt of Giant Strength (fire)
Belt of Giant Strength (fire).description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgBeltOfGiantSt]

While wearing this belt, your Strength changes to 25. The type of giant determines the score. The item has no effect on you if your Strength without the belt is equal to or greater than 25.

Ioun Stone of Greater Absorption.name: 艾恩石，強效吸收

Utilize (Scale by Spell Level).name: 利用（隨法術等級提升）
Utilize (Scale by Spell Level).condition: when a creature you can see casts a spell of 8th level or lower

Ioun Stone of Greater Absorption.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgIounStone0000]{Ioun Stone}

When you take a Magic action to toss an Ioun Stone into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three Ioun Stones orbiting your head at the same time.

As a Utilize action, you can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head. If your Attunement to an Ioun Stone ends while it’s orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

While this marbled lavender and green ellipsoid orbits your head, you can take a Reaction to cancel a spell of level 8 or lower cast by a creature you can see. A canceled spell has no effect, and any resources used to cast it are wasted. Once the stone has canceled 20 levels of spells, it burns out, turns dull gray, and loses its magic.

Potion of Clairvoyance.name: 銳眼藥水
Potion of Clairvoyance.description:
藥水，珍稀

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你獲得@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplClairvoyan]{銳眼術}法術的效應（無需專注）。

一顆眼球在這瓶藥水泛黃的液體中沉浮，但在藥水被開啟時會消失。

Sage.description: At any time you choose within one year of drawing this card, you can ask a question in meditation and mentally receive a truthful answer to that question.

Mantle of Spell Resistance.name: 法術抗性披肩
Mantle of Spell Resistance.description:
奇物，珍稀（需同調）

穿戴這件斗篷期間，你在對抗法術的豁免中具有優勢。

bO4agG7byTwFTiFg.chatFlavor: Can target only the Silver Raven
bO4agG7byTwFTiFg.target: The Silver Raven in raven form

Silver Raven.name: Silver Raven
Silver Raven.description:
See @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFigurineOfWon]{Figurine of Wondrous Power}

This silver statuette of a raven can become a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobRaven00000]{Raven} for up to 12 hours. Once it has been used, it can’t be used again until 2 days have passed. While in raven form, the figurine grants you the ability to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplAnimalMess]{Animal Messenger} on it.

Foundry Note

This item's limited uses represent the 2 days required before the figurine can be used again.

Elemental Gem (Yellow Diamond).description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgElementalGem0]

This gem contains a mote of elemental energy. When you take a Utilize action to break the gem, an @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.sApYLZj9PTZ40wJr] is summoned, and the gem ceases to be magical. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the broken gem as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action.

Utilize.name: Utilize
Utilize.target: unoccupied space as close to the broken gem as possible

Card Effect.name: Card Effect
Card Effect.target: all magic items you wear or carry

Talons.description: Every magic item you wear or carry disintegrates. Artifacts in your possession vanish instead.
Talons.name: Talons

Green Slime.description:
Nuisance Hazard (Levels 1–4)

Actor: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.dmgGreenSlime000]{Green Slime}

Acidic green slime devours flesh, organic material, and metal on contact. Bright green, wet, and sticky, it clings to walls, floors, and ceilings in patches.

One patch of green slime covers a 5-foot square. Green slime has Blindsight with a range of 30 feet, and it drops from walls and ceilings when it detects movement below itself. Beyond that, it can’t move. A creature aware of the slime’s presence can avoid being struck by it with a successful DC 10 Dexterity saving throw.

A creature that comes in contact with green slime takes 5 (1d10) Acid damage. The creature takes the damage again at the start of each of its turns until the slime is scraped off (requiring an action) or destroyed. Against wood or metal, green slime deals 11 (2d10) Acid damage each round, and any nonmagical wood or metal item used to scrape off the green slime is destroyed.

Direct sunlight or any amount of Cold, Fire, or Radiant damage destroys a patch of green slime.
Green Slime.name: Green Slime

Cast-Off Armor.description:
護甲（任意輕甲、中甲或重甲），普通

你可以採取魔法動作來脫下這套護甲。

Ring，珍稀（需同調）

When you fall while wearing this ring, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.

Mace of Terror.description:
武器（@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepMace000000]{硬頭錘}），珍稀（需同調）

這把魔法武器具有3點充能，並在每日黎明時恢復1d3點已消耗的充能。持握這把武器期間，你可以採取魔法動作並消耗1點充能，從武器中釋放一股恐懼波動。位於你30呎內每名你所選擇的生物都必須成功通過一次DC 15的感知豁免，否則陷入&Reference[Frightened apply=false]{恐慌}狀態，持續1分鐘。以此方式陷入恐慌的生物必須在其回合盡可能遠離你，且無法進行藉機攻擊。該生物只能採取疾走動作，或嘗試擺脫阻止其移動的效應。若無處可移動，該生物可以採取迴避動作。在其每個回合結束時，該生物重複此豁免，成功時結束其身上的效應。
Mace of Terror.name: 恐懼之錘

Pipe of Smoke Monsters.description:
奇物，普通

抽這支煙斗期間，你可以採取魔法動作，吐出一口呈現生物形狀的煙，例如龍、呋嚕或史拉蟾。該形狀必須小到能放進1呎立方體的空間中，並在數秒後失去形狀，變回一般的煙。
Pipe of Smoke Monsters.name: 怪物煙斗

Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals.description:
奇物，珍稀

當這個水缽盛滿水且你位於其5呎內時，你可以採取魔法動作召喚一個@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.namJz755U1EhvEJa]{水元素}。該水元素會出現在距離水缽最近的未佔據空間，理解你所說的語言、服從你的命令，並緊接在你的先攻順位後進行其回合。水元素會在1小時後、其死亡時，或你採取附贈動作解除召喚時消失。直到下個黎明前，水缽都無法再以此方式使用。

水缽直徑約1呎，深約半呎，可容納約3加侖的水。
Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals.name: 命令水元素水缽

summon.target: 距離水缽最近的未佔據空間

Ring of Water Walking.name: 水行戒指
Ring of Water Walking.description:
Ring，非普通

While wearing this ring, you cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWaterWalk0]{Water Walk} from it, targeting only yourself.

Ioun Stone of Insight.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgIounStone0000]{Ioun Stone}

When you take a Magic action to toss an Ioun Stone into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three Ioun Stones orbiting your head at the same time.

As a Utilize action, you can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head. If your Attunement to an Ioun Stone ends while it’s orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

Your Wisdom increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this incandescent blue sphere orbits your head.

Enhanced Insight: Wisdom Bonus.description: Your Wisdom increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this incandescent blue sphere orbits your head.
Enhanced Insight: Wisdom Bonus.name: Enhanced Insight: Wisdom Bonus

Ioun Stone of Insight.name: 艾恩石，洞悉

Snare Missile.condition: 被遠程武器或投擲武器的攻擊檢定命中
Snare Missile.name: 奪箭

Gloves of Missile Snaring.name: 避矢奪箭手套
Gloves of Missile Snaring.description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

穿戴這雙手套期間，若你被以遠程武器或投擲武器所進行的攻擊檢定命中，且你有一隻空出的手，你可以採取反應將傷害減少1d10 + 你的敏捷調整值。若你將傷害減少至0，且該彈藥或武器小到足以讓你用那隻手握持，你可以接住該彈藥或武器。

奇物，非常珍稀（需同調）

While touching this crystal orb, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplScrying000]{Scrying} (save DC 17) with it.
Crystal Ball.name: 水晶球

Fireball Fungus.description:
Deadly Hazard (Levels 5–10)

Actor: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.dmgFireballFungu]{Fireball Fungus}

A fireball fungus is a Small, inanimate mushroom that can grow anywhere fungi are found in abundance. Its luminous, orange cap sheds Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 feet.

A fireball fungus has AC 10, HP 6, and to Immunity Psychic damage. When it drops to 0 Hit Points, the fungus explodes as if a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFireball00]{Fireball} spell (save DC 15) had been centered on it.

At Higher Levels. The explosion of a fireball fungus causes other fireball fungi in the area of effect to explode as well. You can scale the hazard for higher levels by adding one additional fungus at levels 11–16 or three additional fungi at levels 17–20.
Fireball Fungus.name: Fireball Fungus

Wand of Fireballs.description:
魔杖，珍稀（需由施法者同調）

這根魔杖具有7點充能。持握魔杖期間，你可以消耗至多3點充能，透過魔杖施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFireball00]{火球術}（豁免DC 15）。消耗1點充能時，你施放該法術的3環版本；每多消耗1點充能，法術的環階就提升1環。

【恢復充能】該魔杖每日黎明時恢復1d6 + 1已消耗的充能。若你消耗了魔杖的最後1點充能，擲[[/r 1d20]]。若結果為1，魔杖會化為灰燼並被摧毀。
Wand of Fireballs.name: 火球魔杖

Periapt of Wound Closure.description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

佩戴這枚吊墜期間，你獲得下列好處。

【維持生命】每當你進行死亡豁免時，你可以將9或更低的擲骰結果改為10，使失敗的豁免變為成功。

【加速自癒】每當你擲生命骰來恢復生命值時，該生命骰所恢復的生命值加倍。
Periapt of Wound Closure.name: 辟毒護身符

Potion of Mind Reading.description:
藥水，珍稀

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你獲得@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDetectThou]{偵測思想}法術的效應（豁免DC 13），持續10分鐘（無需專注）。

這瓶藥水濃稠的紫色液體中漂浮著一團橢圓形的粉色雲霧。
Potion of Mind Reading.name: 讀心藥水

Quaal's Feather Token (Tree).name: Quaal's Feather Token (Tree)
Quaal's Feather Token (Tree).description:
奇物，非普通, See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgQuaalsFeather]{Quaal's Feather Token}

You must be outdoors to use this token. You can take a Magic action to touch it to an unoccupied space on the ground. The token disappears, and in its place a nonmagical oak tree springs into existence. The tree is 60 feet tall and has a 5-foot-diameter trunk, and its branches at the top spread out in a 20-foot radius.

Ring of Mind Shielding.name: 心靈護盾戒指
Ring of Mind Shielding.description:
Ring，非普通（需同調）

While wearing this ring, you are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, determine whether you are lying, know your alignment, or know your creature type. Creatures can telepathically communicate with you only if you allow it.

You can take a Magic action to cause the ring to become imperceptible until you take another Magic action to make it perceptible, until you remove the ring, or until you die.

If you die while wearing the ring, your soul enters it, unless it already houses a soul. You can remain in the ring or depart for the afterlife. As long as your soul is in the ring, you can telepathically communicate with any creature wearing it. A wearer can’t prevent this telepathic communication.

Oil of Etherealness.description:
藥水，珍稀

一小瓶這種油可以覆蓋一名中型或更小的生物，連同其穿戴與攜帶的裝備（每高於中型一個體型等級，就需要多一小瓶）。塗抹油需要10分鐘。被影響的生物接著獲得@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplEtherealne]{跨入乙太界}法術的效應，持續1小時。

這種混濁的灰色油珠會在容器外壁上形成，並迅速蒸發。
Oil of Etherealness.name: 乙太化之油

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你恢復2d4 + 2生命值。

無論藥效如何，這瓶藥水的紅色液體在搖晃時都會閃爍。

Quaal's Feather Token (Whip).description:
奇物，珍稀, See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgQuaalsFeather]{Quaal's Feather Token}

You can take a Magic action to throw the token to a point within 10 feet of yourself. The token disappears, and a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.dmgqftFloatingWh]{floating whip} takes its place. You can then take a Bonus Action to make a melee spell attack against a creature within 10 feet of the whip, with an attack bonus of +9. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 + 5 Force damage.

As a Bonus Action, you can direct the whip to fly up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 10 feet of the whip. The whip disappears after 1 hour, when you take a Magic action to dismiss it, or when you die or have the Incapacitated condition.
Quaal's Feather Token (Whip).name: Quaal's Feather Token (Whip)

Wand of Orcus.name: Wand of Orcus
Wand of Orcus.description:
Wand, Artifact（需同調）

Lore

Crafted and wielded by Orcus, this ghastly wand slips from the demon lord’s grasp from time to time. When it does, it magically appears wherever the demon lord senses an opportunity to achieve some fell goal.

The wand is topped with a skull that once belonged to a human hero slain by Orcus. The wand can magically change in size to better conform to the grip of its user. All Holy Water within 10 feet of the wand is destroyed.

Any creature besides Orcus that tries to attune to the wand makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the creature takes 10d6 Necrotic damage. On a failed save, the creature dies and, if it is a Humanoid, turns into a Zombie.

Magic Weapon. You can wield the wand as a magic Mace that grants a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. The wand deals an extra 2d12 Necrotic damage on a hit.

Random Properties

Random Properties. The Wand of Orcus has the following random properties (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgMagicItems000.JournalEntryPage.iA3mHmvlXvWKlyBo#artifact-properties]{Artifacts} in this chapter):

  • 2 @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgMinorBenefici]{minor beneficial properties}
  • 1 @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgMajorBenefici]{major beneficial property}
  • 2 @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgMinorDetrimen]{minor detrimental properties}
  • 1 @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgMajorDetrimen]{major detrimental property}

The detrimental properties of the Wand of Orcus are suppressed while the wand is attuned to Orcus.

Protection. You gain a +3 bonus to Armor Class while holding the wand.

Spell Charge Cost Table

Spells. The wand has 7 charges and regains 1d4 + 3 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding the wand, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it (save DC 18). The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

Spell

Charge Cost

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplAnimateDea]{Animate Dead}

1

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplBlight0000]{Blight}

2

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplCircleofDe]{Circle of Death}

3

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFingerofDe]{Finger of Death}

3

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplPowerWordK]{Power Word Kill}

4

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSpeakwithD]{Speak with Dead}

1

While attuned to the wand, Orcus or a follower blessed by him can cast each of the wand’s spells using 2 fewer charges (minimum of 0).

Call Undead. While holding the wand, you can take a Magic action to conjure 15 Skeletons and 15 Zombies. These Undead magically rise up from the ground or otherwise form in unoccupied spaces within 300 feet of you and obey your commands until they are destroyed or until the next dawn, when they collapse into inanimate piles of bones and rotting corpses. Once you use this property, you can’t use it again until the next dawn.

While holding the wand, Orcus can summon any kind of Undead, not just skeletons and zombies. These Undead don’t perish at dawn the following day, remaining until Orcus dismisses them.

Sentience/Personality

Sentience. The Wand of Orcus is a sentient Chaotic Evil item with an Intelligence of 16, a Wisdom of 12, and a Charisma of 16. It has hearing and Darkvision out to 120 feet.

The wand communicates telepathically with its wielder and speaks Abyssal and Common.

Personality. The wand’s purpose is to help satisfy Orcus’s desire to slay everything in the multiverse. The wand is cruel, nihilistic, and bereft of humor.

To further Orcus’s goals, the wand feigns devotion to its current user and makes grandiose promises that it has no intention of fulfilling, such as vowing to help its user overthrow Orcus.

Destroying the Wand. Destroying the Wand of Orcus requires that it be taken to the Positive Energy Plane by the ancient hero whose skull surmounts it. For this to happen, the long-lost hero must first be restored to life—no easy task, given the fact that Orcus has imprisoned the hero’s soul and keeps it hidden and well guarded.

Bathing the wand in positive energy (such as that which permeates the Positive Plane) causes it to crack and explode, but unless the above conditions are met, the wand instantly re-forms on Orcus’s layer of the Abyss.

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你獲得@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplComprehend]{通曉語言}法術的效應，持續1小時。
