Art Object (250 GP).description: Idols cast of solid gold, necklaces studded with precious stones, paintings of ancient kings, bejeweled dishes—art objects include all these and more.

Bag of Devouring.description:
此袋子表現上與@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgBagOfHolding0]極為相似，但其實際上是某個超巨型異次元生物的進食孔。將袋子裡外翻轉將會關閉這個進食孔。

這個吞噬袋所依附的異次元生物可以感測到任何被放入這個袋子內的事物。被整個放入袋中的動物或植物將被吞噬並永久遺失。當活體生物的一部份被放入袋中時（例如當某人將手伸進袋中時），該生物會有[[/r 1dc#Creature pulled in on a 1, or "Heads"]]{50％}的機率被拖入袋中。一個進入袋中的生物可以採取動作並成功通過一次[[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=15 format=long]]檢定以嘗試逃脫。另一個生物也可以採取動作以伸進袋中，成功通過一次[[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=20 format=long]]檢定以將一個生物拉出（只要它沒有先被拖入袋中）。任何在這個袋子中開始其回合的生物將被吞噬，且其身體將被摧毀。

無生命體可以被儲存在這個袋子中，且這個袋子最多可以容納1立方呎的物質。然而，每天一次，這個袋子將會吞下任何存放在其中的物體，並將其吐到另一個存在位面。DM將決定其吞嚥的時間和物體被吐至的位面。

若袋子被戳破或撕裂，則其將被摧毀，且其裝載的任何東西都將被傳送到星界位面的一處隨機位置。
Bag of Devouring.name: 吞噬袋

Rust Bag of Tricks.description:
奇物，非普通

這種布袋有三種不同顏色的版本：灰色、鐵鏽色、棕褐色。布袋看起來空無一物，但把手伸進去會摸到一個小小的毛絨物體。

你可以採取魔法動作取出布袋裡的毛絨物體，並將其扔出至多20呎遠。當物體落地時，投骰參考對應顏色布袋的表格決定物體變成的生物。該生物的數值面板見《怪物圖鑑》。該生物在下個黎明時分或其生命值降至0時消失。

該生物對你和你的盟友態度友好，並緊接在你的先攻順位後行動。你可以採取附贈動作命令該生物在其下個回合如何移動、採取什麼動作，例如攻擊你的敵人。沒接到命令時，該生物會依其本性行動。

一旦袋子抽出三件毛絨物體後，直到下個黎明前都無法再次使用。

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgRustBagOfTric rollable]

Pull and Throw.chatFlavor: 由DM決定或擲表決定變成的生物
Pull and Throw.name: 取出並扔出
Pull and Throw.duration: 直到下個黎明，或該生物的生命值降至0時。

Rust Bag of Tricks.name: 鐵鏽色魔術袋

Staff of Charming.name: 魅惑法杖
Staff of Charming.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbafcStaffalsoa]{法杖}，珍稀（需由吟遊詩人、牧師、德魯伊、術士、契術師或法師同調）

這根法杖具有10點充能。持握法杖期間，你可以使用其下列任一屬性：

【施放法術】你可以消耗法杖的1點充能，透過法杖施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplCharmPerso]{魅惑人類}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplCommand000]{命令術}或@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplComprehend]{通曉語言}，使用你的法術豁免DC。

【反射惑控】若你在對抗一道只以你為目標的惑控學派法術中豁免成功，你可以採取反應消耗法杖的1點充能，將該法術反射回其施法者，如同該法術由你施放一般。

【抵抗惑控】若你在對抗一道只以你為目標的惑控學派法術的豁免中失敗，你可以將失敗的豁免改為成功。直到下個黎明前，你無法再次使用法杖的此屬性。

【恢復充能】此法杖每日黎明時恢復1d8 + 2已消耗的充能。若你消耗了最後1點充能，擲1d20。若結果為1，法杖會化為塵土並被摧毀。

Potion of Animal Friendship.name: 化獸為友藥水
Potion of Animal Friendship.description:
藥水，非普通

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你可以施放3環版本的@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplAnimalFrie]{化獸為友}法術（豁免DC 13）。

攪動這瓶藥水的混濁液體時，會看見一些細小的東西：一片魚鱗、一根蜂鳥羽毛、一根貓爪，或一根松鼠毛。

Mystery Key.name: 神秘鑰匙
Mystery Key.description:
奇物，普通

這把鑰匙的頭部刻有一個問號。此鑰匙有5%的機率能打開任何被其插入的鎖。一旦打開了某物，這把鑰匙就會消失。

Foundry 註記

名為機率擲骰的行動在成功時會回傳「1」，否則回傳「0」。

Hat of Wizardry.description:
奇物，普通（需由法師同調）

這頂錐形帽上點綴著月亮與星辰。你穿戴此帽期間，你獲得下列好處。

【施法法器】你可以將此帽作為你的法師法術的施法法器。

【未知法術】以一個魔法動作，你可以嘗試施放一道你尚未習得的戲法。該戲法必須位於法師法術列表中，且施法時間為一個動作，並且你要進行一次DC 10的智力（奧秘）檢定。檢定成功時，你施放該法術；檢定失敗時，該法術施放失敗，且用於施法的動作被浪費。無論成功與否，直到你完成一次長休前，你都無法再次使用此屬性。
Hat of Wizardry.name: 巫術帽

Necklace of Fireballs.name: 火球項鍊
Necklace of Fireballs.description:
奇物，珍稀

這條項鍊上掛著1d6 + 3顆珠子。你可以採取魔法動作取下一顆珠子，並將其投擲至多60呎遠。當珠子抵達其軌跡終點時，會引爆為3環的@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFireball00]{火球術}（豁免DC 15）。

你可以一次擲出多顆珠子，甚至整條項鍊。這麼做時，第一顆之後每多一顆珠子，就使火球術的傷害增加1d6（上限為12d6）。

Foundry 註記

此物品包含9次有限使用次數。可使用判定珠子數量行動來判定項鍊上有多少顆珠子（等同於1d6 + 3）。

也可使用投擲珠子行動，將火球術的威力提升至最多12d6。

Horseshoes of Speed.description:
奇物，珍稀

這些馬蹄鐵四個為一套。你可以採取魔法動作將其中一個馬蹄鐵與一匹馬或類似生物的蹄子接觸，隨後馬蹄鐵就會附著在蹄子上。移除一個馬蹄鐵也需要採取魔法動作。

當四個馬蹄鐵都附著在同一生物身上期間，其速度增加30呎。
Horseshoes of Speed.name: 加速馬蹄鐵

Medallion of Thoughts.name: 讀心勳章
Medallion of Thoughts.description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

這枚勳章具有5點充能。佩戴勳章期間，你可以消耗1點充能，透過勳章施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDetectThou]{偵測思想}（豁免DC 13）。勳章每日黎明時恢復1d4已消耗的充能。

Figurine of Wondrous Power.description:
奇物, Rarity Varies

A Figurine of Wondrous Power is a statuette small enough to fit in a pocket. If you take a Magic action to throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of yourself, the figurine becomes a living creature specified in the figurine’s description below. If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn’t enough space for the creature, the figurine doesn’t become a creature.

The creature is Friendly to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions.

The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if its creature form drops to 0 Hit Points or if you take a Magic action while touching the creature to make it revert to figurine form. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can’t be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified in the figurine’s description.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFwpBronzeGrif]{Bronze Griffon (Rare)}

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFwpEbonyFlyRa]{Ebony Fly (Rare)}

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFwpGoldenLion]{Golden Lions (Rare)}

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFwpIvoryGoats]{Ivory Goats (Rare)}

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFwpMarbleElep]{Marble Elephant (Rare)}

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFwpObsidianSt]{Obsidian Steed (Very Rare)}

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFwpOnyxDogRar]{Onyx Dog (Rare)}

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFwpSerpentine]{Serpentine Owl (Rare)}

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFwpSilverRave]{Silver Raven (Uncommon)}
Figurine of Wondrous Power.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power

Necklace of Prayer Beads.description:
奇物，珍稀（需由牧師、德魯伊或聖騎士同調）

這條項鍊上有[[/r 1d4 + 2#Magic beads]]顆由海藍寶石、黑珍珠或黃玉製成的魔法念珠。項鍊上還有許多由琥珀、血石、黃水晶、珊瑚、翡翠、珍珠或石英等石材製成的非魔法念珠。若魔法念珠被從項鍊上取下，該念珠便失去其魔法。

魔法念珠共有六種。DM決定項鍊上每顆念珠的種類，或透過在下表擲骰隨機決定。一條項鍊可以有多顆同種類的念珠。要使用念珠，你必須佩戴著這條項鍊。每顆念珠蘊含一道法術，你可以採取附贈動作透過念珠施放該法術（若需要豁免，則使用你的法術豁免DC）。魔法念珠的法術一經施放，直到下個黎明前，該念珠都無法再次使用。

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgNecklaceOfPra caption=false rollable]

Foundry 註記

此物品為每道每黎明有使用次數限制的法術各包含一個行動。在將項鍊交給玩家之前，你可以移除這條項鍊上不存在的念珠所對應的行動，並複製出現多次的念珠所對應的行動。
Necklace of Prayer Beads.name: 念珠項鍊

Cli Lyre Instrument of the Bards.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgInstrumentOfT]{Instrument of the Bards}

An Instrument of the Bards is superior to an ordinary instrument in every way.

A creature that attempts to play the instrument without being attuned to it must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=15 format=long]] or take [[/damage 2d4 type=psychic]] damage.

You can play the instrument to cast one of its spells. Once the instrument has been used to cast a spell, it can’t be used to cast that spell again until the next dawn. The spells use your spellcasting ability and spell save DC.
Cli Lyre Instrument of the Bards.name: Cli Lyre Instrument of the Bards

Lit Candle of Invocation.name: Lit Candle of Invocation
Lit Candle of Invocation.description: While lit, the candle sheds Dim Light in a 30-foot radius. While you are within that light, you have Advantage on D20 Tests. In addition, a Cleric or Druid in the light can cast level 1 spells they have prepared without expending spell slots.

Candle of Invocation.name: 祈神蠟燭
Candle of Invocation.description:
奇物，非常珍稀（需同調）

This candle’s magic is activated when the candle is lit, which requires a Magic action. After burning for 4 hours, the candle is destroyed. You can snuff it out early for use at a later time. Deduct the time it burned in increments of 1 minute from its total burn time.

While lit, the candle sheds Dim Light in a 30-foot radius. While you are within that light, you have Advantage on D20 Tests. In addition, a Cleric or Druid in the light can cast level 1 spells they have prepared without expending spell slots.

Alternatively, when you light the candle for the first time, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGate000000]{Gate} with it. Doing so destroys the candle. The portal created by the spell links to a particular Outer Plane chosen by the DM or determined by rolling on the following table.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgCandleOfInvoc rollable]

Gemstone (1,000 GP).name: Gemstone (1,000 GP)
Gemstone (1,000 GP).description: Gemstones are small, lightweight, and easily secured compared to their same value in coins.

Stone of Good Luck (Luckstone).description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

在你隨身攜帶這塊光亮的瑪瑙期間，你在屬性檢定和豁免上獲得+1加值。

Foundry 註記

這件物品包含一個Active Effect，用於自動套用該加值。
Stone of Good Luck (Luckstone).name: 幸運石

Wyvern Poison.name: Wyvern Poison
Wyvern Poison.description:
Injury Poison

A creature subjected to Wyvern Poison makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Pole of Angling.name: 垂釣長桿
Pole of Angling.description:
奇物，普通

此物品的功能等同於一根@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagPole0000000]{長桿}。持握其期間，你可以採取魔法動作，使其變形為附有魚鉤、釣線和捲線器的釣竿，或使釣竿恢復為長桿。

Antimatter Rifle.description:
Reload (2 shots)

Foundry Note

This item includes a max use of 2 for ammunition tracking. The Reload activities can be used to reset that amount.
Antimatter Rifle.name: Antimatter Rifle

Bronze Griffon.description:
See @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFigurineOfWon]{Figurine of Wondrous Power}

This bronze statuette is of a griffon rampant. It can become a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.h052EIIUmRwJum65]{Griffon} for up to 6 hours. Once it has been used, it can’t be used again until 5 days have passed.

Foundry Note

This item's limited uses represent the 5 days required before the figurine can be used again.
Bronze Griffon.name: Bronze Griffon

Ring of Regeneration.description:
Ring，非常珍稀（需同調）

While wearing this ring, you regain 1d6 Hit Points every 10 minutes if you have at least 1 Hit Point. If you lose a body part, the ring causes the missing part to regrow and return to full functionality after [[/r 1d6 + 1]] days if you have at least 1 Hit Point the whole time.

Foundry Note

The Heal activity allows you to enter the number of 10 minute increments that have passed and will automatically scale the healing formula. For example, if it's been an hour, you can enter 6 and it will roll 6d6.
Ring of Regeneration.name: 再生戒指

Malice.description:
Inhaled Poison

A creature subjected to Malice must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition for 1 hour. The creature also has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] condition while Poisoned in this way.
Malice.name: Malice

Ring of Telekinesis.name: 心靈遙控戒指
Ring of Telekinesis.description:
Ring，非常珍稀（需同調）

While wearing this ring, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplTelekinesi]{Telekinesis} from it.

Regeneration.condition: once per hour if you have at least 1 Hit Point
Regeneration.name: Regeneration

Ioun Stone of Regneration.name: Ioun Stone of Regneration
Ioun Stone of Regneration.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgIounStone0000]{Ioun Stone}

When you take a Magic action to toss an Ioun Stone into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three Ioun Stones orbiting your head at the same time.

As a Utilize action, you can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head. If your Attunement to an Ioun Stone ends while it’s orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

You regain [[/healing 15 type=healing]]{15 Hit Points} at the end of each hour this pearly white spindle orbits your head if you have at least 1 Hit Point.

Red Corundum.name: 紅寶石
Red Corundum.target: 距離被打破的寶石最近的未佔據空間

Yellow Diamond.name: 黃鑽
Yellow Diamond.target: 距離被打破的寶石最近的未佔據空間

Emerald.name: 綠寶石
Emerald.target: 距離被打破的寶石最近的未佔據空間

Blue Sapphire.name: 藍寶石
Blue Sapphire.target: 距離被打破寶石最近的未佔據空間

Elemental Gem.name: 元素寶石
Elemental Gem.description:
奇物，非普通

這枚寶石蘊含了一道元素能量的微塵。當你採取利用動作打破寶石時，會召喚出一隻元素，且寶石失去魔法。元素會出現在距離被打破的寶石最近的未佔據空間，理解你所說的語言、服從你的命令，並在你的先攻順位上緊接在你之後進行其回合。元素會在1小時後、其死亡時，或你採取附贈動作解除召喚時消失。寶石的種類決定了其能召喚哪種元素，如下表所示：

寶石召喚的元素
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgBlueElemental]{藍寶石}@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.banHjKDMCegbUwYE]{氣元素}
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgEmeraldElemen]{綠寶石}@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.namJz755U1EhvEJa]{水元素}
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgRedElementalG]{紅寶石}@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.8SMQl75HLjhuSeau]{火元素}
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgYellowElement]{黃鑽}@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.sApYLZj9PTZ40wJr]{土元素}

Eyes of Charming.description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

這副水晶鏡片適合戴在眼前。鏡片具有3點充能。佩戴鏡片期間，你可以消耗1點或更多充能來施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplCharmPerso]{魅惑人類}（豁免DC 13）。消耗1點充能時，你施放該法術的1環版本；每多消耗1點充能，法術的環階就提升1環。鏡片每日黎明時恢復所有已消耗的充能。
Eyes of Charming.name: 魅惑鏡片

Bomb.description: As an action, you can light a Bomb and throw it at a point up to 60 feet away, where it explodes. Each creature in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
Bomb.name: Bomb

Quaal's Feather Token.description:
奇物, Rarity Varies

This object looks like a feather. Different types of feather tokens exist, each with a different single-use effect. The DM chooses the kind of token or determines it randomly by rolling on the Quaal’s Feather Tokens table. The type of token determines its rarity.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgQuaalsFeather caption=false rollable]
Quaal's Feather Token.name: Quaal's Feather Token

Wind Fan.name: 造風之扇
Wind Fan.description:
奇物，非普通

持握這把扇子時，你可以用該扇子施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGustofWind]{造風術}（豁免DC 13）。在下個黎明之前，隨後每一次使用這把扇子都會累積20%的機率失效；若扇子失效，則其會被撕裂成無用的非魔法碎片。

擲骰判定失效機率： [[/r 1d5cs>@item.uses.spent]]

Foundry 註記

每次施放造風術都會消耗這件物品的一次使用次數，並在黎明時重置。上方的行內擲骰會擲1d5，並檢查結果是否高於已使用次數，以處理累積20%的失效機率。成功時回傳「1」，失敗時回傳「0」。

Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals.name: 命令火元素火盆
Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals.description:
奇物，珍稀

當你位於這座火盆5呎內時，你可以採取魔法動作召喚一個@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.8SMQl75HLjhuSeau]{火元素}。火元素會出現在距離火盆最近的未佔據空間，理解你所說的語言、服從你的命令，並緊接在你的先攻順位後進行其回合。該火元素會在1小時後、其死亡時，或你採取附贈動作解除召喚時消失。直到下個黎明前，火盆都無法再以此方式使用。

summon.target: 距離火盆最近的未佔據空間

Orb of Time.name: 時間法球
Orb of Time.description:
奇物，普通

這顆法球可用作奧術法器。

持握這顆法球期間，你可以採取魔法動作，確認現在是早晨、下午、傍晚還是夜晚。此屬性僅在物質位面中有效。

Amulet of Proof against Detection and Lo.description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

佩戴這枚護符期間，除非你允許，否則你無法被&Reference[schoolsofmagic]{預言學派}法術選為目標，也無法被魔法探知感應器感知。
Amulet of Proof against Detection and Lo.name: 反偵測定位護符

Ring of Jumping.description:
Ring，非普通（需同調）

While wearing this ring, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplJump000000]{Jump} from it, but can target only yourself when you do so.
Ring of Jumping.name: 跳躍戒指

Wand of Binding.description:
魔杖，珍稀（需同調）

這根魔杖具有7點充能。

【法術】持握魔杖期間，你可以透過魔杖施放下表中的一道法術（豁免DC 17）。下表列出施放各法術所需消耗的充能。

法術

充能消耗

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplHoldMonste]{怪物定身術}

5

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplHoldPerson]{人類定身術}

2

【恢復充能】此魔杖每日黎明時恢復1d6 + 1已消耗的充能。若你消耗了魔杖的最後1點充能，擲[[/r 1d20]]。若結果為1，魔杖會化為灰燼並被摧毀。
Wand of Binding.name: 定身魔杖

Candle of the Deep.name: 深淵蠟燭
Candle of the Deep.description:
奇物，普通

這根蠟燭的火焰浸入水中也不會熄滅。其發出的光與熱如同普通蠟燭。

Potion of Healing (Supreme).name: 極效治療藥水
Potion of Healing (Supreme).description:
藥水，極珍稀

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你恢復10d4 + 20生命值。

無論藥效如何，這瓶藥水的紅色液體在搖晃時都會閃爍。

Belt of Giant Strength (cloud).name: Belt of Giant Strength (cloud)
Belt of Giant Strength (cloud).description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgBeltOfGiantSt]

While wearing this belt, your Strength changes to 27. The type of giant determines the score. The item has no effect on you if your Strength without the belt is equal to or greater than 27.

Potion of Giant Strength (Stone).name: 石巨人之力藥水
Potion of Giant Strength (Stone).description:
藥水，珍稀

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你的力量屬性值會在1小時內變為23。巨人的種類決定該屬性值。若你的力量等於或高於該值，這瓶藥水對你無效。

這瓶藥水的透明液體中漂浮著一縷形似巨人指甲的光絲。

Hat of Vermin.name: 害蟲之帽
Hat of Vermin.description:
奇物，普通

此帽有3次充能。持握此帽期間，你可以採取魔法動作，消耗1充能，召喚你所選擇的下列生物之一：一隻@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.qav2dvMIUiMQCCsy]{蝙蝠}、一隻@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.EZgiprHXA2D7Uyb3]{青蛙}或一隻@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.pozQUPTnLZW8epox]{老鼠}。被召喚出的生物會魔法般地出現在帽子中，並試圖盡快遠離你。該生物對你和其他生物的態度為冷漠，且不受你控制。其行為如同同類的普通生物，並在1小時後或生命值降至0時消失。此帽每日黎明時恢復所有已消耗的充能。

Cape of the Mountebank.description:
奇物，珍稀

這件披肩帶有淡淡的硫磺氣味。穿戴這件披肩期間，你可以透過披肩，以魔法動作施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDimensionD]{次元門}。此屬性一經使用，直到下個黎明前都無法再次使用。

當你以該法術傳送時，你會留下一團煙霧。你離開的空間會因該煙霧而處於&Reference[LightlyObscured]{輕度遮蔽}，直到你下個回合結束。

qsuojT0nn8ZkAY19.chatFlavor: 你離開的空間因煙霧而處於&Reference[LightlyObscured]{輕度遮蔽}，直到你下個回合結束。

Cape of the Mountebank.name: 郎中披肩

Hat of Disguise.name: 易容帽
Hat of Disguise.description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

穿戴這頂帽子期間，你可以施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDisguiseSe]{易容術}法術。若帽子被摘下，法術便結束。

Pot of Awakening.description:
奇物，普通

若你在這個重10磅的陶盆中種下一株普通灌木，並讓其生長30天，時間一到，該灌木就會魔法般地轉變為一株@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.actors.Actor.gaSTr7DFZJLmgI2J]{啟蒙灌木}。灌木被啟蒙時，其根系會撐破花盆，使其毀壞。

這株啟蒙灌木對你友善，並服從你的命令。若你未下達命令，其什麼也不會做。
Pot of Awakening.name: 啟蒙盆栽

Ring of Spell Storing.description:
Ring，珍稀（需同調）

This ring stores spells cast into it, holding them until the attuned wearer uses them. The ring can store up to 5 levels worth of spells at a time. When found, it contains [[/r 1d6 − 1]] levels of stored spells chosen by the DM.

Any creature can cast a spell of level 1 through 5 into the ring by touching the ring as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect other than to be stored in the ring. If the ring can’t hold the spell, the spell is expended without effect. The level of the slot used to cast the spell determines how much space it uses.

While wearing this ring, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster but is otherwise treated as if you cast the spell. The spell cast from the ring is no longer stored in it, freeing up space.

Foundry Note

To store a spell in this ring, drag the spell onto the Activities tab to create a "Cast a Spell" activity. Then change to the "Spell" tab, set the "Casting Level", check the "Override Values" box and enter the relevant Attack Bonus and Save DC from the original caster's values. You will then be able to cast that spell from this ring without expending your own slots. You will then need to delete the activity since each spell is a one-time use.
Ring of Spell Storing.name: 法術儲存戒指

Headband of Intellect.description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

穿戴這條頭帶期間，你的智力變為19。若你在未穿戴它時的智力就已經為19或更高，則這條頭帶對你將不會有任何效果。
Headband of Intellect.name: 智力頭帶

Essence of Ether.description:
Inhaled Poison

A creature subjected to Essence of Ether must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition for 8 hours. The creature also has the &Reference[Unconscious apply=false] condition while Poisoned in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
Essence of Ether.name: Essence of Ether

Shield of Missile Attraction.description:
護甲（盾牌），珍稀（需同調）

持握這面盾牌期間，你對以遠程武器進行的攻擊所造成的傷害具有抗力。

【詛咒】這面盾牌被詛咒了。與其同調會使你受到詛咒，直到你成為@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplRemoveCurs]{移除詛咒}法術或類似魔法的目標。卸下該盾牌不會終止你身上的詛咒。每當遠程武器所進行的攻擊，以位於你10呎內的一名生物為目標時，詛咒會使你代替該生物成為目標。
Shield of Missile Attraction.name: 飛彈吸引之盾

Wand of Enemy Detection.name: 搜敵魔杖
Wand of Enemy Detection.description:
魔杖，珍稀（需同調）

這根魔杖具有7點充能。持握魔杖期間，你可以採取魔法動作消耗1點充能。在1分鐘內，你能得知位於你60呎內、離你最近的敵對生物所在方向，但無法得知你與其的距離。魔杖能感知處於隱形、乙太化、偽裝或躲藏狀態的敵對生物，以及明顯可見的敵對生物。若你不再持握魔杖，效應便結束。

【恢復充能】該魔杖每日黎明時恢復1d6 + 1已消耗的充能。若你消耗了魔杖的最後1點充能，擲[[/r 1d20]]。若結果為1，魔杖會化為灰燼並被摧毀。

Ioun Stone of Reserve.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgIounStone0000]{Ioun Stone}

When you take a Magic action to toss an Ioun Stone into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three Ioun Stones orbiting your head at the same time.

As a Utilize action, you can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head. If your Attunement to an Ioun Stone ends while it’s orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

This vibrant purple prism stores spells cast into it, holding them until you use them. The stone can store up to 4 levels of spells at a time. When found, it contains [[/r 1d4#Spell Levels]] levels of stored spells chosen by the DM.

Any creature can cast a spell of level 1 through 4 into the stone by touching it as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect, other than to be stored in the stone. If the stone can’t hold the spell, the spell is expended without effect. The level of the slot used to cast the spell determines how much space it uses.

While this stone orbits your head, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster but is otherwise treated as if you cast the spell. The spell cast from the stone is no longer stored in it, freeing up space.
Ioun Stone of Reserve.name: 艾恩石，儲法

Staff of Adornment.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbafcStaffalsoa]{法杖}，普通

持握此法杖期間，若你將一件重量不超過1磅的超小型物件（例如一片水晶碎片、一顆蛋或一塊石頭）放在法杖尖端上方，該物件就會懸浮在距離杖尖1吋處，並停留在那裡，直到被移除或法杖不再由你持有為止。法杖尖端上方同一時間最多可懸浮三件這類物件。持握法杖期間，你可以使其中一件或多件物件緩慢地旋轉或原地轉動。
Staff of Adornment.name: 飾品法杖

Golden Lions.description:
See @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFigurineOfWon]{Figurine of Wondrous Power}

These gold statuettes of lions are always created in pairs. You can use one figurine or both simultaneously. Each can become a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobLion000000]{Lion} for up to 1 hour. Once a lion has been used, it can’t be used again until 7 days have passed.

Foundry Note

Each Use Lion activity has limited uses which represent the 7 days required before that particular paired figurine can be used again.
Golden Lions.name: Golden Lions

Prosthetic Limb.name: 義肢
Prosthetic Limb.description:
奇物，普通

這件魔法物品能替代失去的肢體，例如手、手臂、腳、腿，或類似的身體部位。義肢安裝期間，其功能與所替代的部位完全相同。你能以魔法動作來卸下或重新安裝，且只要你還活著，便無法違背你的意願將其移除。

Potion of Giant Strength (Fire).name: 火巨人之力藥水
Potion of Giant Strength (Fire).description:
藥水，珍稀

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你的力量屬性值會在1小時內變為25。巨人的種類決定該屬性值。若你的力量等於或高於該值，這瓶藥水對你無效。

這瓶藥水的透明液體中漂浮著一縷形似巨人指甲的光絲。

Belt of Giant Strength (frost).name: Belt of Giant Strength (frost)
Belt of Giant Strength (frost).description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgBeltOfGiantSt]

While wearing this belt, your Strength changes to 23. The type of giant determines the score. The item has no effect on you if your Strength without the belt is equal to or greater than 23.

Necklace of Adaptation.description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

佩戴這條項鍊期間，你能在任何環境中正常呼吸，且你在為避免或結束&Reference[Poisoned apply=false]{中毒}狀態而進行的豁免中具有優勢。
Necklace of Adaptation.name: 適應項鍊

Nature's Mantle.description:
奇物，非普通（需由德魯伊或遊俠同調）

這件斗篷的顏色與質地會隨你周遭的地形而變化，與之融為一體。穿戴這件斗篷期間，你可以將其作為你的德魯伊與遊俠法術的施法法器。

當你身處&Reference[Lightly Obscured]{輕度遮蔽}的區域時，即使你正被直接觀察，也可以採取附贈動作來躲藏。
Nature's Mantle.name: 自然斗篷

Boots of False Tracks.name: 偽跡之靴
Boots of False Tracks.description:
奇物，普通（需同調）

穿著這雙靴子期間，你可以令其留下與你體型相同的任意一種類人生物的足跡。

Glamoured Studded Leather.name: 幻惑鑲釘皮甲
Glamoured Studded Leather.description:
護甲（鑲釘皮甲），珍稀

穿戴這套護甲期間，你的AC獲得+1加值。你也可以採取附贈動作，使這套護甲呈現一套普通衣物或其他種類護甲的外觀。你決定該外觀，包括顏色、樣式和配飾，但護甲保持其原本的體積和重量。幻化外觀持續到你再次使用此屬性或脫下該護甲為止。

Enhanced Protection: +1 AC.name: Enhanced Protection: +1 AC
Enhanced Protection: +1 AC.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class while this dusty-rose prism orbits your head.

Ioun Stone of Protection.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgIounStone0000]{Ioun Stone}

When you take a Magic action to toss an Ioun Stone into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three Ioun Stones orbiting your head at the same time.

As a Utilize action, you can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head. If your Attunement to an Ioun Stone ends while it’s orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class while this dusty-rose prism orbits your head.
Ioun Stone of Protection.name: 艾恩石，防護

Folding Boat.name: 摺疊船
Folding Boat.description:
奇物，珍稀

這個物體外觀看起來是個長12吋、寬6吋、深6吋的木盒。其重4磅且能在水面上漂浮，也可以像普通木盒一樣裝東西。這件物品有三個命令詞，使用每個命令詞都需要採取魔法動作：

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgBoatUtility00 caption=false]

Clawed Gauntlet.name: Clawed Gauntlet
Clawed Gauntlet.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgDemonArmor000]

The armor’s clawed gauntlets allow your Unarmed Strikes to deal 1d8 Slashing damage instead of the usual Bludgeoning damage, and you gain a +1 bonus to the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes.

Sanctuary Charm.description: After spending a Long Rest in your Bastion, you gain a magical Charm (see @UUID[JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.U9qU1oUFTPAK7g50]{Supernatural Gifts}) that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The Charm allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplHealingWor]{Healing Word} once without expending a spell slot. You can’t gain this Charm again while you still have it.
Sanctuary Charm.name: Sanctuary Charm

Fochlucan Bandore Instrument of the Bard.name: Fochlucan Bandore Instrument of the Bards
Fochlucan Bandore Instrument of the Bard.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgInstrumentOfT]{Instrument of the Bards}

An Instrument of the Bards is superior to an ordinary instrument in every way.

A creature that attempts to play the instrument without being attuned to it must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=15 format=long]] or take [[/damage 2d4 type=psychic]] damage.

You can play the instrument to cast one of its spells. Once the instrument has been used to cast a spell, it can’t be used to cast that spell again until the next dawn. The spells use your spellcasting ability and spell save DC.

Wand of Fear.name: 恐懼魔杖
Wand of Fear.description:
魔杖，珍稀（需同調）

這根魔杖具有7點充能。

【法術】持握魔杖期間，你可以透過魔杖施放下表中的一道法術（豁免DC 15）。下表列出施放各法術所需消耗的充能。

法術

充能消耗

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplCommand000]{命令術}（僅限「滾」或「趴下」）

1

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFear000000]{恐懼術}（60呎錐形）

3

【恢復充能】該魔杖每日黎明時恢復1d6 + 1已消耗的充能。若你消耗了魔杖的最後1點充能，擲[[/r 1d20]]。若結果為1，魔杖會化為灰燼並被摧毀。

Grenade Launcher.description:
As an action, you can use a Grenade Launcher to propel a grenade to a point up to 1,000 feet away. The grenade explodes at that point, creating a particular effect in a 20-foot-radius Sphere.

Fragmentation Grenade. Each creature in the Sphere makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Smoke Grenade. The area of the Sphere is Heavily Obscured by smoke for 1 minute. A strong wind (such as the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGustofWind]{Gust of Wind} spell) disperses the smoke.
Grenade Launcher.name: Grenade Launcher

Cloak of Protection.description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

穿戴這件斗篷期間，你的護甲等級與豁免檢定獲得+1加值。
Cloak of Protection.name: 防護斗篷

Laser Pistol.description:
Reload (50 shots)

Foundry Note

This item includes a max use of 50 for ammunition tracking. The Reload activities can be used to reset that amount.
Laser Pistol.name: Laser Pistol

Elixir of Health.name: 健康靈藥
Elixir of Health.description:
藥水，珍稀

這種清澈的紅色液體中有著發光的微小氣泡。

當你飲用這瓶藥水時，你身上的所有魔法疫病都會被治癒。此外，你身上的下列狀態將會結束：&Reference[Blinded]{目盲}、&Reference[Deafened]{耳聾}、&Reference[Paralyzed]{麻痺}以及&Reference[Poisoned]{中毒}。

Ring of Free Action.description:
Ring，珍稀（需同調）

While you wear this ring, &Reference[Difficult Terrain] doesn’t cost you extra movement. In addition, magic can neither reduce any of your Speeds nor cause you to have the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] or &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition.
Ring of Free Action.name: 自由行動戒指

Wand of Polymorph.name: 變形魔杖
Wand of Polymorph.description:
魔杖，非常珍稀（需由施法者同調）

This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplPolymorph0]{Polymorph} (save DC 15) from it.

Regaining Charges. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll [[/r 1d20]]. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

Slippers of Spider Climbing.description:
奇物，非普通（需同調）

穿戴這雙輕便鞋期間，你能在垂直表面上上下左右移動，也能沿著天花板移動，同時雙手保持空閒。你具有等同於你速度的攀爬速度。然而，在滑溜的表面上，例如覆蓋著冰或油的表面，拖鞋無法讓你以這種方式移動。
Slippers of Spider Climbing.name: 蛛行拖鞋

Crystal Ball of True Seeing.name: 真知水晶球
Crystal Ball of True Seeing.description:
奇物, Legendary（需同調）

While touching this crystal orb, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplScrying000]{Scrying} (save DC 17) with it. In addition, you have Truesight with a range of 120 feet centered on the spell’s sensor.

Ersatz Eye.name: 人造義眼
Ersatz Eye.description:
奇物，普通

這隻魔法義眼可取代遺失或被摘除的真眼。當人造義眼嵌入你的眼窩時，你可以透過這顆小小的球體視物，如同使用天然的眼睛一般。你能以魔法動作來嵌入或取出人造義眼，且只要你還活著，便無法違背你的意願將其取出。

Art Object (2,500 GP).name: Art Object (2,500 GP)
Art Object (2,500 GP).description: Idols cast of solid gold, necklaces studded with precious stones, paintings of ancient kings, bejeweled dishes—art objects include all these and more.

Regeneration.condition: once per hour if you have at least 1 Hit Point
Regeneration.name: Regeneration

Ioun Stone of Regeneration.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgIounStone0000]{Ioun Stone}

When you take a Magic action to toss an Ioun Stone into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three Ioun Stones orbiting your head at the same time.

As a Utilize action, you can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head. If your Attunement to an Ioun Stone ends while it’s orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

You regain [[/healing 15 type=healing]]{15 Hit Points} at the end of each hour this pearly white spindle orbits your head if you have at least 1 Hit Point.
Ioun Stone of Regeneration.name: Ioun Stone of Regeneration
